title: Rethinking Visual Provenance: Detection and Watermarking Across Direct Visual Generation and LLM-Driven Code Rendering
title_zh: 重新思考视觉来源：直接视觉生成与 LLM 驱动代码渲染中的检测与水印技术

paragraphs.en: AI systems create images and videos with image/video generation models or by writing code and graphics descriptions that are then rendered. These routes can produce similar visible artifacts but expose different representations, intervention points, and provenance evidence. We develop a production-centered framework that compares detection and watermarking across both routes. An explicit verification specification distinguishes passive inference, message recovery, and authenticated provenance. We organize image, video, source-code, and rendering-aware watermarks by production stage. We examine the different requirements of generated images and video, plots and SVG, programmable video, and agent-composed workflows. Documented Claude, OpenAI, and rendering-tool interfaces connect the framework to concrete systems. We pose ten scoped research questions on identifiability, observability, fair comparison across stages, recoverable payload, reconstruction, synchronization, composition, hybrid local contribution, and private production-event authentication. The result is a conceptual research agenda grounded in published methods, inspected interfaces, and elementary boundary examples. It reports no experiments and claims no new theorems; its appendix results are elementary calculations, and documentation and source inspection establish interfaces, not empirical robustness.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能系统通过图像/视频生成模型，或编写代码和图形描述后再进行渲染，来创建图像和视频。 这些路径可能产生相似的可见人工产物，但会暴露不同的表示形式、干预点以及来源证据。 我们开发了一个以生产为中心的框架，用于比较这两种路径下的检测与水印技术。 一种明确的验证规范能够区分被动推理、消息恢复和经过认证的来源信息。 我们将图像、视频、源代码以及具备渲染感知能力的水印按生产阶段进行组织。 我们研究了生成图像和视频、图表与 SVG、可编程视频以及智能体组合工作流的不同需求。 已文档化的 Claude、OpenAI 和渲染工具接口将框架与具体系统连接起来。 我们提出了十个范围明确的研究问题，涉及可识别性、可观察性、跨阶段的公平比较、可恢复的有效载荷、重建、同步、组合、混合本地贡献以及私密的生产事件认证。 最终成果是一项概念性的研究议程，其基础是已发表的方法、经过检验的接口以及基本的边界示例。 该研究未报告任何实验，也未声称提出新的定理；其附录中的结果仅为基本计算，而文档和源代码的审查仅用于确认接口，而非验证经验上的稳健性。

paragraphs.en: A visual explanation can come from image/video models ( image/video generation ) or from rendered code and graphics descriptions ( code-based rendering ). 1 1 1 These are working labels for composable operations, not disjoint model families. The title’s “direct visual generation” means image/video generation; “direct” includes latent decoding and does not exclude code implementation or agent orchestration. Code-based rendering interprets explicit programs or declarative graphics such as SVG. Diffusion models provide image and video examples, and the documented Claude Code–Remotion workflow provides a code-based example [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 视觉解释可以来自图像/视频模型（图像/视频生成），也可以来自渲染的代码和图形描述（基于代码的渲染）。这些是用于组合操作的临时标签，而非相互独立的模型类别。 标题中的“直接视觉生成”指的是图像/视频生成；“直接”包括潜在空间解码，并不排除代码实现或智能体协调。 基于代码的渲染会解释显式程序或声明式图形（如 SVG）。 扩散模型提供了图像和视频示例，而文档中记载的 Claude Code–Remotion 工作流程则提供了一个基于代码的示例 [1, 2, 3, 4]。

paragraphs.en: Viewers may receive neither source nor intermediate state nor execution records, so the visible artifact reveals only part of its production.
paragraphs.zh: 观看者可能既收不到源状态，也收不到中间状态或执行记录，因此可见的最终产物仅能揭示其生成过程的一部分。

paragraphs.en: Consider an animation of a ball that follows a curve and carries a speed label. It could be synthesized, calculated and rendered, or composed from a generated background, programmed motion, and recorded narration. These implementations serve the same communication task but expose different intervention and observation points (Figure Abstract ), potentially coordinated by a human or agent.
paragraphs.zh: 设想一个球的动画，它沿着一条曲线运动，并带有速度标签。 这个动画可以通过合成、计算和渲染生成，也可以由生成的背景、编程的运动和录制的旁白组合而成。 这些实现方式服务于相同的传达任务，但提供了不同的干预和观察点（图 Abstract），这些点可能由人类或智能体进行协调。

sents.en: Consider an animation of a ball that follows a curve and carries a speed label.
sents.zh: 设想一个球的动画，它沿着一条曲线运动，并带有速度标签。

sents.en: It could be synthesized, calculated and rendered, or composed from a generated background, programmed motion, and recorded narration.
sents.zh: 这个动画可以通过合成、计算和渲染生成，也可以由生成的背景、编程的运动和录制的旁白组合而成。

sents.en: These implementations serve the same communication task but expose different intervention and observation points (Figure Abstract ), potentially coordinated by a human or agent.

paragraphs.en: The output format does not determine the provenance question. An MP4 file may contain synthesized footage, rendered graphics, recorded material, or a composition. A static image can arise from a learned image tool or executed plotting code, two distinct operations in OpenAI’s documentation [ 5 , 6 ] . Claude’s documented custom visuals yield an HTML or SVG description that can be downloaded and inspected [ 7 ] . Receiving that description and receiving a raster snapshot provide different observations.
paragraphs.zh: 输出格式并不决定来源问题。 MP4 文件可能包含合成的视频片段、渲染的图形、录制的素材或组合画面。 静态图像可能来自学习型图像工具或已执行的绘图代码，这两者在 OpenAI 的文档中属于两种不同的操作 [5, 6]。 Claude 文档中提到的自定义视觉效果会生成 HTML 或 SVG 描述，这些描述可以下载并进行检查 [7]。 接收该描述与接收位图快照所提供的观察信息是不同的。

paragraphs.en: The distinction concerns operations rather than model families: generators can accept language, assistants can author code, and programs can include generated assets. An LLM agent can control several operations and does not define an exclusive origin class. Remotion’s Prompt to Video template combines generated script, images, and voiceover [ 8 ] , which motivates a workflow of connected synthesis, rendering, and composition stages.
paragraphs.zh: 这种区别涉及操作而非模型家族：生成器可以接受语言输入，助手可以编写代码，而程序则可以包含生成的资源。 LLM 智能体可以控制多种操作，但并不定义一个排他的源类。 Remotion 的“提示到视频”模板结合了生成的脚本、图像和旁白 [ 8 ]，这促使形成一种由相互连接的合成、渲染和构图阶段组成的工作流程。

sents.en: The distinction concerns operations rather than model families: generators can accept language, assistants can author code, and programs can include generated assets.
sents.zh: 这种区别涉及操作而非模型家族：生成器可以接受语言输入，助手可以编写代码，而程序则可以包含生成的资源。

paragraphs.en: Evidence must reach the intended verifier. An interpreter may ignore a source mark, and a screenshot may omit file credentials. Changes to emitted colors can reach pixels. Video Seal marks video, SrcMarker targets program representations, and CopyRNeRF connects a marked representation to rendered views [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] . Comparing them requires locating both intervention and observation, not assuming interchangeable carriers.
paragraphs.zh: 证据必须送达预期的验证者。 解释器可能会忽略源标记，而截图可能不包含文件凭据。 对输出颜色的修改可以影响像素。 Video Seal 标记视频，SrcMarker 针对程序表示，而 CopyRNeRF 则将标记的表示与渲染视图连接起来 [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] 。 要比较它们，需要同时定位干预和观察，而不能假设载体可以互换。

sents.en: Evidence must reach the intended verifier.
sents.zh: 证据必须送达预期的验证者。

sents.en: An interpreter may ignore a source mark, and a screenshot may omit file credentials.
sents.zh: 解释器可能会忽略源标记，而截图可能不包含文件凭据。

sents.en: Changes to emitted colors can reach pixels.
sents.zh: 对输出颜色的修改可以影响像素。

sents.en: Video Seal marks video, SrcMarker targets program representations, and CopyRNeRF connects a marked representation to rendered views [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] .
sents.zh: Video Seal 标记视频，SrcMarker 针对程序表示，而 CopyRNeRF 则将标记的表示与渲染视图连接起来 [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] 。

sents.zh: 要比较它们，需要同时定位干预和观察，而不能假设载体可以互换。

paragraphs.en: A signal needs a precise interpretation. Passive inference estimates a production label without a mark. Watermark verification tests for a mark (detection) or estimates its embedded message (message recovery). Authentication checks an issuer-bound assertion about content or about a production event. A production event is one invocation of a production step, such as one generation call, one rendering run, or one export. It is not the event that the video depicts.
paragraphs.zh: 信号需要精确的解读。 被动推理在没有标记的情况下估计生成标签。 水印验证会检测是否存在标记（检测），或估计其嵌入的消息（消息恢复）。 身份验证会检查与发行方相关的关于内容或生成事件的断言。 生成事件是生成步骤的一次调用，例如一次生成调用、一次渲染运行或一次导出。 它并非视频所描绘的事件本身。

sents.en: A signal needs a precise interpretation.
sents.zh: 信号需要精确的解读。

sents.en: Passive inference estimates a production label without a mark.
sents.zh: 被动推理在没有标记的情况下估计生成标签。

sents.en: Watermark verification tests for a mark (detection) or estimates its embedded message (message recovery).
sents.zh: 水印验证会检测是否存在标记（检测），或估计其嵌入的消息（消息恢复）。

sents.en: Authentication checks an issuer-bound assertion about content or about a production event.
sents.zh: 身份验证会检查与发行方相关的关于内容或生成事件的断言。

sents.en: A production event is one invocation of a production step, such as one generation call, one rendering run, or one export.
sents.zh: 生成事件是生成步骤的一次调用，例如一次生成调用、一次渲染运行或一次导出。

sents.en: It is not the event that the video depicts.
sents.zh: 它并非视频所描绘的事件本身。

paragraphs.en: In this article, detection covers passive inference and watermark detection; message recovery and authentication are the other verification tasks (Section 2.3 ). A mark applied by a rendering service can concern processing of human-authored code, and a texture mark concerns an asset, but neither identifies every contributor. The Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (C2PA) specifies Content Credentials [ 12 ] . Their assertions, signed claims, and trust relationships make the scope of the authenticated assertion explicit [ 12 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，检测涵盖被动推理和水印检测；消息恢复和身份验证是其他验证任务（第 2.3 节）。 渲染服务所应用的标记可能涉及对人类编写的代码进行处理，而纹理标记则与某个资产相关，但两者都无法识别所有贡献者。 内容来源与真实性联盟（C2PA）规定了内容凭证 [ 12 ] 。 其断言、签名声明和信任关系明确了经身份验证的断言的范围 [ 12 ] 。

sents.zh: 在本文中，检测涵盖被动推理和水印检测；消息恢复和身份验证是其他验证任务（第 2.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Robustness depends on access and permissions. Recompression, source editing, rerendering, and clean-asset replacement act on different objects (Section 3 ). Pixel-only and source-visible attackers therefore have different capabilities, and deployments place code, logs, and keys under different control. Remotion’s server, browser, and Lambda backends provide concrete examples [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] . A recovery claim must declare the accessible state and the allowed transformations.
paragraphs.zh: 稳健性取决于访问权限和授权。 重新压缩、源文件编辑、重新渲染以及干净资产替换作用于不同的对象（第 3 节）。 因此，仅针对像素的攻击者与可访问源文件的攻击者具有不同的能力，而部署则将代码、日志和密钥置于不同的控制之下。 Remotion 的服务器、浏览器和 Lambda 后端提供了具体的示例 [13, 14, 15]。 恢复声明必须明确可访问的状态以及允许的操作转换。

sents.en: Robustness depends on access and permissions.
sents.zh: 稳健性取决于访问权限和授权。

sents.en: Recompression, source editing, rerendering, and clean-asset replacement act on different objects (Section 3 ).
sents.zh: 重新压缩、源文件编辑、重新渲染以及干净资产替换作用于不同的对象（第 3 节）。

sents.en: Pixel-only and source-visible attackers therefore have different capabilities, and deployments place code, logs, and keys under different control.
sents.zh: 因此，仅针对像素的攻击者与可访问源文件的攻击者具有不同的能力，而部署则将代码、日志和密钥置于不同的控制之下。

sents.en: Remotion’s server, browser, and Lambda backends provide concrete examples [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] .
sents.zh: Remotion 的服务器、浏览器和 Lambda 后端提供了具体的示例 [13, 14, 15]。

sents.en: A recovery claim must declare the accessible state and the allowed transformations.
sents.zh: 恢复声明必须明确可访问的状态以及允许的操作转换。

paragraphs.en: We state the following seven items together as one verification specification (Section 2.2 ). It declares:
paragraphs.zh: 我们将以下七项内容合并表述为一个验证规范（第 2.2 节）。该规范声明如下：

paragraphs.en: the encoder’s allowed observations and interventions;
paragraphs.zh: 编码器的允许观察和干预；

paragraphs.en: the attacker’s view and allowed policies;
paragraphs.zh: 攻击者的视角和允许的策略；

paragraphs.en: the assertion under test, together with the verification task;
paragraphs.zh: 待测试的断言以及验证任务；

paragraphs.en: the null family of unmarked observation laws.
paragraphs.zh: 无标记观测定律的零族。

paragraphs.en: Key generation, issuance queries, and verifier permissions complete it. The specification distinguishes a pixel-only authorship test, a source-visible message-recovery decoder, and a trusted export record by the assumptions each needs.
paragraphs.zh: 密钥生成、签发查询和验证者权限可完成此操作。 该规范区分了仅基于像素的作者身份测试、源可见的消息恢复解码器以及可信导出记录，并明确了每种方法所需的假设条件。

sents.en: Key generation, issuance queries, and verifier permissions complete it.
sents.zh: 密钥生成、签发查询和验证者权限可完成此操作。

sents.en: The specification distinguishes a pixel-only authorship test, a source-visible message-recovery decoder, and a trusted export record by the assumptions each needs.
sents.zh: 该规范区分了仅基于像素的作者身份测试、源可见的消息恢复解码器以及可信导出记录，并明确了每种方法所需的假设条件。

paragraphs.en: Evidence can remain partial. An authenticated asset may have undocumented later composition, and a negative detector result may leave several histories possible. Preserving uncertainty and allowing abstention prevents origin evidence from being overinterpreted as complete authorship, authorization, or truth of the depicted event.
paragraphs.zh: 证据可能并不完整。 经过验证的资产可能存在未记录的后继构成，而检测结果的否定也可能使多种历史可能性仍然存在。 保留不确定性并允许弃权，可以防止将起源证据过度解读为完整的作者身份、授权或所描绘事件的真实性。

sents.en: Evidence can remain partial.
sents.zh: 证据可能并不完整。

sents.en: An authenticated asset may have undocumented later composition, and a negative detector result may leave several histories possible.

sents.en: Preserving uncertainty and allowing abstention prevents origin evidence from being overinterpreted as complete authorship, authorization, or truth of the depicted event.
sents.zh: 保留不确定性并允许弃权，可以防止将起源证据过度解读为完整的作者身份、授权或所描绘事件的真实性。

paragraphs.en: We connect image/video watermarking, source-code and rendering-aware precedents, documented workflows, and ten scoped research questions. Elementary boundary examples show when information is lost or transmitted. The questions set restricted targets for definitions, constructions, attacks, or conditional limits.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将图像/视频水印、源代码和渲染感知先例、已记录的工作流程以及十个限定范围的研究问题联系起来。 基本的边界示例展示了信息在何时丢失或传输。 这些问题为定义、构造、攻击或条件限制设定了受限的目标。

sents.en: We connect image/video watermarking, source-code and rendering-aware precedents, documented workflows, and ten scoped research questions.
sents.zh: 我们将图像/视频水印、源代码和渲染感知先例、已记录的工作流程以及十个限定范围的研究问题联系起来。

sents.en: Elementary boundary examples show when information is lost or transmitted.
sents.zh: 基本的边界示例展示了信息在何时丢失或传输。

sents.en: The questions set restricted targets for definitions, constructions, attacks, or conditional limits.
sents.zh: 这些问题为定义、构造、攻击或条件限制设定了受限的目标。

paragraphs.en: Limits of the article. The article is a conceptual research agenda. We report no experiments, no new theorems, no empirical benchmark, and no new construction claimed to meet the ten questions. Documentation and source inspection establish interfaces, not empirical robustness or measured watermark performance. The numbered appendix results are standard facts or direct calculations that make the boundary examples checkable. The image versions of Figures Abstract , 2 , 3 , 5 , and 6 are schematic illustrations made with an image-generation tool and carry no empirical content.
paragraphs.zh: 本文的局限性。 本文是一项概念性的研究议程。 我们未报告任何实验、新定理、经验基准，也未提出任何声称满足十个问题的新构造。 文档和源代码检查可以确定接口，但无法证明经验上的鲁棒性或经测量的水印性能。 编号附录中的结果均为标准事实或直接计算，这使得边界示例具有可验证性。 图“摘要”、图2、图3、图5和图6的图像版本是使用图像生成工具制作的示意图，不包含任何经验内容。

paragraphs.en: Image/video generation and code-based rendering are operations that a workflow can combine. Image/video generation uses an image/video model to produce pixels or a representation that is then decoded into pixels. Code-based rendering executes or interprets an explicit drawing program, animation, or graphics description under a specified environment. The two operations can overlap: neural rendering combines learned components with graphics operations [ 16 ] . A program can call an image/video model or reuse generated footage, and an LLM can write SVG or plotting code.
paragraphs.zh: 图像/视频生成和基于代码的渲染是工作流程可以结合使用的操作。 图像/视频生成使用图像/视频模型来产生像素或某种表示形式，然后将其解码为像素。 基于代码的渲染在指定环境中执行或解释显式的绘制程序、动画或图形描述。 这两种操作可以重叠：神经渲染将学习到的组件与图形操作相结合 [ 16 ] 。 一个程序可以调用图像/视频模型或复用已生成的视频素材，而大型语言模型（LLM）可以编写 SVG 或绘图代码。

paragraphs.en: A claim about a verifier of one representation cannot silently transfer to a verifier of another. The same production can expose several artifacts: source code, a scene or asset representation, a browser preview, decoded pixels, an encoded file, and accompanying credentials. Fonts, resources, viewport, frame rate, and runtime can affect the map between them. Figure Abstract summarizes the operations, and Figure 2 isolates the observation boundary.

sents.en: The production specification 𝔓 = ( 𝒢 , ( F v ) v ∈ 𝒩 , ( μ x ) x ) \mathfrak{P}=(\mathcal{G},(F_{v})_{v\in\mathcal{N}},(\mu_{x})_{x}) consists of the graph, the node maps, and the input laws μ x \mu_{x} of the task instances x x .
sents.zh: 生成规范 𝔓 = ( 𝒢 , ( F v ) v ∈ 𝒩 , ( μ x ) x ) \mathfrak{P}=(\mathcal{G},(F_{v})_{v\in\mathcal{N}},(\mu_{x})_{x}) 由图、节点映射以及任务实例 x x 的输入法则 μ x \mu_{x} 组成。

sents.en: The symbol ℐ \mathcal{I} denotes the encoder’s allowed observations and interventions.
sents.zh: 符号 ℐ \mathcal{I} 表示编码器被允许的观察和干预。

paragraphs.en: Key generation, issuance queries, and verifier permissions complete this specification. Intervention stages alone do not specify their access. A source-editing attacker and a received-image editor belong to different 𝒜 \mathcal{A} even when both return pixels.
paragraphs.zh: 密钥生成、签发查询和验证器权限共同构成了本规范。 仅凭干预阶段本身无法明确其访问权限。 即使两者都返回像素，源编辑攻击者与接收图像编辑器仍属于不同的 𝒜 \mathcal{A}。

sents.en: Key generation, issuance queries, and verifier permissions complete this specification.
sents.zh: 密钥生成、签发查询和验证器权限共同构成了本规范。

sents.en: Intervention stages alone do not specify their access.
sents.zh: 仅凭干预阶段本身无法明确其访问权限。

sents.en: A source-editing attacker and a received-image editor belong to different 𝒜 \mathcal{A} even when both return pixels.
sents.zh: 即使两者都返回像素，源编辑攻击者与接收图像编辑器仍属于不同的 𝒜 \mathcal{A}。

paragraphs.en: An encoder or attacker may use only its declared view. An upstream intervention records allowed changes to inputs or node maps, then executes the affected downstream nodes under a declared rerun-randomness law. It is not permission to replace every artifact independently.
paragraphs.zh: 编码器或攻击者可能仅使用其声明的视图。 上游干预会记录对输入或节点映射的允许更改，然后在声明的重运行随机性法则下执行受影响的下游节点。 这并不意味着可以独立替换每个组件。

sents.en: An encoder or attacker may use only its declared view.
sents.zh: 编码器或攻击者可能仅使用其声明的视图。

sents.en: An upstream intervention records allowed changes to inputs or node maps, then executes the affected downstream nodes under a declared rerun-randomness law.

sents.en: It is not permission to replace every artifact independently.
sents.zh: 这并不意味着可以独立替换每个组件。

paragraphs.en: In the first bounded models, require task preservation almost surely for encoding and allowed attack policies. A model that allows task-preservation failures must instead state their probability and treatment. Section 2.3 states recovery and false-alarm requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 在第一个有界模型中，编码和允许的攻击策略几乎必然需要任务保留。 允许任务保留失败的模型必须转而声明其概率和处理方式。 第 2.3 节说明了恢复和误报要求。

sents.en: In the first bounded models, require task preservation almost surely for encoding and allowed attack policies.
sents.zh: 在第一个有界模型中，编码和允许的攻击策略几乎必然需要任务保留。

sents.en: A model that allows task-preservation failures must instead state their probability and treatment.
sents.zh: 允许任务保留失败的模型必须转而声明其概率和处理方式。

sents.en: Section 2.3 states recovery and false-alarm requirements.
sents.zh: 第 2.3 节说明了恢复和误报要求。

paragraphs.en: Passive inference, watermark verification, and authentication support different assertions. Passive inference estimates a production label without arranging to mark the output. Watermark verification includes watermark detection , which tests for a mark, and message recovery (payload extraction), which estimates its embedded message.
paragraphs.zh: 被动推理、水印验证和身份验证支持不同的断言。 被动推理无需安排标记输出，即可估算一个生产标签。 水印验证包括水印检测（用于检验是否存在标记）和信息恢复（即有效载荷提取），后者用于估算其嵌入的信息。

sents.en: Passive inference, watermark verification, and authentication support different assertions.
sents.zh: 被动推理、水印验证和身份验证支持不同的断言。

sents.en: Passive inference estimates a production label without arranging to mark the output.
sents.zh: 被动推理无需安排标记输出，即可估算一个生产标签。

sents.en: Watermark verification includes watermark detection , which tests for a mark, and message recovery (payload extraction), which estimates its embedded message.
sents.zh: 水印验证包括水印检测（用于检验是否存在标记）和信息恢复（即有效载荷提取），后者用于估算其嵌入的信息。

paragraphs.en: Authentication checks an issuer-bound assertion under declared trust assumptions. Our questions about production events additionally bind an artifact or allowed derivative to an authorized production event. Signed assertions and content binding follow C2PA terminology (Appendix D ; [ 12 ] ). State the guarantees of the three tasks and the assertions they support separately.
paragraphs.zh: 身份验证在声明的信任假设下检查一个与签发者绑定的断言。 我们对生产事件的疑问还进一步将某个工件或允许的衍生品与授权的生产事件绑定在一起。 签名断言和内容绑定遵循 C2PA 术语（附录 D；[12]）。 分别说明三项任务的保障以及它们所支持的断言。

sents.en: Authentication checks an issuer-bound assertion under declared trust assumptions.
sents.zh: 身份验证在声明的信任假设下检查一个与签发者绑定的断言。

sents.en: Our questions about production events additionally bind an artifact or allowed derivative to an authorized production event.
sents.zh: 我们对生产事件的疑问还进一步将某个工件或允许的衍生品与授权的生产事件绑定在一起。

sents.en: Signed assertions and content binding follow C2PA terminology (Appendix D ; [ 12 ] ).
sents.zh: 签名断言和内容绑定遵循 C2PA 术语（附录 D；[12]）。

sents.en: State the guarantees of the three tasks and the assertions they support separately.
sents.zh: 分别说明三项任务的保障以及它们所支持的断言。

paragraphs.en: Watermark Forensics separates detection, attribution, payload extraction, and localization [ 18 ] . These statistical objectives help specify the visual verifier’s task, but the source assumptions and rate results of that work need a separate model before they transfer to rendering or video editing.
paragraphs.zh: 水印法证将检测、归属判定、有效载荷提取和定位区分开来 [ 18 ] 。 这些统计目标有助于明确视觉验证器的任务，但该研究中的源假设和速率结果在应用于渲染或视频编辑之前，需要一个独立的模型。

sents.en: Watermark Forensics separates detection, attribution, payload extraction, and localization [ 18 ] .
sents.zh: 水印法证将检测、归属判定、有效载荷提取和定位区分开来 [ 18 ] 。

sents.en: These statistical objectives help specify the visual verifier’s task, but the source assumptions and rate results of that work need a separate model before they transfer to rendering or video editing.
sents.zh: 这些统计目标有助于明确视觉验证器的任务，但该研究中的源假设和速率结果在应用于渲染或视频编辑之前，需要一个独立的模型。

paragraphs.en: For example, a trusted rendering service can mark a video made from human-authored code. The mark could support an assertion about service participation, but it does not identify the code’s author.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，一个受信任的渲染服务可以为由人类编写的代码生成的视频添加标记。 该标记可以支持对服务参与情况的声明，但它并未标识出代码的作者。

sents.en: For example, a trusted rendering service can mark a video made from human-authored code.
sents.zh: 例如，一个受信任的渲染服务可以为由人类编写的代码生成的视频添加标记。

sents.en: The mark could support an assertion about service participation, but it does not identify the code’s author.
sents.zh: 该标记可以支持对服务参与情况的声明，但它并未标识出代码的作者。

paragraphs.en: An animation can retain a mark from a generated texture while separate authoring produces most of the composition, and a provider might sign a file it converts without being the original source of the ideas it represents. None of these situations invalidates the narrower evidence, but its interpretation must travel with the detection protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 动画可以保留来自生成纹理的标记，而独立的创作过程则负责构建大部分构图；同时，提供者可能在转换文件时为其签名，即便他们并非所表达理念的最初来源。 这些情况中的任何一种都不会使更狭窄的证据失效，但其解释必须与检测协议一同适用。

sents.en: An animation can retain a mark from a generated texture while separate authoring produces most of the composition, and a provider might sign a file it converts without being the original source of the ideas it represents.

paragraphs.en: Absence of a detected mark does not certify that no AI contributed. An unknown generator, changed carrier, or unavailable evidence may leave the verifier unable to decide. Conversely, recovering a mark does not establish the truth of the depicted event or the completeness of the reported history. The verifier should be able to reject or abstain when the evidence does not support the assertion under test.
paragraphs.zh: 未检测到标记并不意味着没有人工智能参与。 未知的生成器、被更改的载体或证据缺失，可能导致验证者无法做出判断。 反之，恢复出标记也无法证明所描述事件为真，或所报告的历史完整无误。 当证据不足以支持待检验的断言时，验证者应能拒绝该断言或选择弃权。

sents.en: Absence of a detected mark does not certify that no AI contributed.
sents.zh: 未检测到标记并不意味着没有人工智能参与。

sents.en: An unknown generator, changed carrier, or unavailable evidence may leave the verifier unable to decide.
sents.zh: 未知的生成器、被更改的载体或证据缺失，可能导致验证者无法做出判断。

sents.en: Conversely, recovering a mark does not establish the truth of the depicted event or the completeness of the reported history.
sents.zh: 反之，恢复出标记也无法证明所描述事件为真，或所报告的历史完整无误。

sents.en: The verifier should be able to reject or abstain when the evidence does not support the assertion under test.
sents.zh: 当证据不足以支持待检验的断言时，验证者应能拒绝该断言或选择弃权。

paragraphs.en: This is a proposed specification, not a guarantee of any cited system. Message recovery does not establish χ \chi automatically: an authenticated production-event assertion additionally needs an authorized relation between production events and content, and an issuance/forgery game. Section 6.6 develops those questions.
paragraphs.zh: 这是一份拟议的规范，而非对任何所引用系统的保证。 消息恢复并不会自动建立 χ \chi：一个经过身份验证的生产事件断言还需要生产事件与内容之间的授权关系，以及一个发行/伪造博弈。 第 6.6 节将展开探讨这些问题。

sents.en: Section 6.6 develops those questions.

paragraphs.en: Rendering can collapse some distinctions while transmitting others. Two different descriptions may render to exactly the same pixels in a fixed environment (Definition B.1 ). Suppose a uniformly selected source message leaves the full observation unchanged and has no message-correlated side information. Then no decoder that sees only that observation, with randomness independent of the message, can beat the best constant guess (Proposition A.5 and Corollary B.3 ). That guess succeeds with probability 1 / N 1/N among N N equally likely messages. This is a conditional boundary, not a claim that one can erase watermarks.
paragraphs.zh: 渲染可能会使某些区分消失，同时保留其他区分。 在固定环境中，两种不同的描述可能会被渲染为完全相同的像素（定义 B.1）。 假设一个均匀选择的源消息未改变完整的观察结果，且没有与消息相关的辅助信息。 那么，任何仅能观察到该结果且其随机性与消息无关的解码器，都无法超越最佳恒定猜测（命题 A.5 和推论 B.3）。 在 N 个等概率的消息中，该猜测成功的概率为 1 / N。 这是一个条件边界，而非声称可以擦除水印。

sents.en: Rendering can collapse some distinctions while transmitting others.
sents.zh: 渲染可能会使某些区分消失，同时保留其他区分。

sents.en: Two different descriptions may render to exactly the same pixels in a fixed environment (Definition B.1 ).
sents.zh: 在固定环境中，两种不同的描述可能会被渲染为完全相同的像素（定义 B.1）。

sents.en: Suppose a uniformly selected source message leaves the full observation unchanged and has no message-correlated side information.
sents.zh: 假设一个均匀选择的源消息未改变完整的观察结果，且没有与消息相关的辅助信息。

sents.en: Then no decoder that sees only that observation, with randomness independent of the message, can beat the best constant guess (Proposition A.5 and Corollary B.3 ).
sents.zh: 那么，任何仅能观察到该结果且其随机性与消息无关的解码器，都无法超越最佳恒定猜测（命题 A.5 和推论 B.3）。

sents.en: That guess succeeds with probability 1 / N 1/N among N N equally likely messages.
sents.zh: 在 N 个等概率的消息中，该猜测成功的概率为 1 / N。

sents.en: This is a conditional boundary, not a claim that one can erase watermarks.
sents.zh: 这是一个条件边界，而非声称可以擦除水印。

paragraphs.en: Source inspection may still distinguish the descriptions (Remark A.6 ). An intervention that affects visible geometry, texture, or decoded content is a different case. Its information can reach the output if the map and task constraints allow it.
paragraphs.zh: 源检查可能仍能区分这些描述（注 A.6）。 影响可见几何形状、纹理或解码内容的干预则属于另一种情况。 如果映射和任务约束允许，其信息可以到达输出。

sents.en: Source inspection may still distinguish the descriptions (Remark A.6 ).

sents.en: An intervention that affects visible geometry, texture, or decoded content is a different case.
sents.zh: 影响可见几何形状、纹理或解码内容的干预则属于另一种情况。

sents.en: Its information can reach the output if the map and task constraints allow it.
sents.zh: 如果映射和任务约束允许，其信息可以到达输出。

paragraphs.en: Conditional equality is also different from equality of population distributions. Human and model authors can choose programs with different probabilities even when the same procedure renders each program. Example A.8 is an artificial case: a human class selects an all-black program with probability three quarters, an LLM class with probability one quarter, and each otherwise selects an all-white program, so the clip laws differ.

paragraphs.en: The article combines published watermark mechanisms, inspected official product and renderer interfaces, and explicitly conditioned mathematical examples. The source library records versions and reading depth: several newer methods are abstract-screened, and selected central methods were read in technical detail. The mechanism map (Table 4 ) lists, for each family, the observation boundary of its examples; its entries are precedents, not security guarantees. Section 1.4 states what documentation and source inspection establish. The ten Questions in Section 6 are bounded in scope.
paragraphs.zh: 本文结合了已发表的数字水印机制、经过检查的官方产品和渲染器接口，以及明确设定条件的数学示例。 源代码库记录了版本和阅读深度：若干较新的方法经过了抽象筛选，而选定的核心方法则被进行了技术细节层面的阅读。 机制地图（表4）列出了每个家族中示例的观察边界；其条目属于先例，而非安全保证。 第1.4节说明了文档和源代码检查所确立的内容。 第6节中的十个问题在范围上均有明确限制。

paragraphs.en: The intervention point determines which evidence can reach the verifier. A producer can mark a finished image, constrain a generator’s internal state, transform source code, modify an asset, or instrument a renderer. These are places where a producer can place a mark, not progressively stronger capability levels. Several can occur in one production graph, and the verifier need not observe the representation that carries the mark. We organize the literature around that separation: what changes during production, what the verifier receives, and what the visual task permits to change.
paragraphs.zh: 干预点决定了哪些证据可以到达验证器。 生产者可以标记一张已完成图像、约束生成器的内部状态、转换源代码、修改资产，或为渲染器添加监控机制。 这些是生产者可以放置标记的位置，而非能力逐步增强的不同层级。 一个生产图中可能同时存在多个此类干预点，且验证器无需观察到承载标记的具体表现形式。 我们围绕这种分离来组织相关文献：生产过程中哪些内容会发生变化、验证器接收到了什么，以及视觉任务允许哪些变化发生。

sents.en: The intervention point determines which evidence can reach the verifier.
sents.zh: 干预点决定了哪些证据可以到达验证器。

paragraphs.en: The five stages map to the production graph (Section 2.2 ) and to Table 2 as follows.
paragraphs.zh: 这五个阶段与生产图（第 2.2 节）以及表 2 的对应关系如下。

paragraphs.en: the final pixel artifact; row Final pixels.
paragraphs.zh: 最终像素伪影；行 最终像素。

paragraphs.en: Z v Z_{v} and F v F_{v} of a generation node; rows Representation, Emission stage.
paragraphs.zh: 一个生成节点的 Z v Z_{v} 和 F v F_{v}；行：表示、排放阶段。

paragraphs.zh: 渲染节点的输入描述；行：请求 / 文本（仅代码标记）和表示。

paragraphs.en: The map is not one-to-one: Representation spans three stages, and Emission stage and Final pixels span two each.
paragraphs.zh: 该映射并非一一对应：表示过程跨越三个阶段，而发射阶段和最终像素各跨越两个阶段。

paragraphs.en: A producer can mark the output of either production route after the route produces pixels. A raster embedder receives an image or video and a message, then modifies the visual signal. Its downstream decoder can operate without knowing which of image/video generation, code-based rendering, or a camera produced the input.
paragraphs.zh: 生产者在路线生成像素后，可以为任一生产路线的输出打上标记。 光栅嵌入器接收图像或视频以及一条消息，然后修改视觉信号。 其下游的解码器无需知道输入是由图像/视频生成、基于代码的渲染还是摄像头产生的，即可正常运行。

sents.zh: 生产者在路线生成像素后，可以为任一生产路线的输出打上标记。

paragraphs.en: HiDDeN learns image embedding and decoding through specified distortion layers [ 19 ] . StegaStamp extends the channel to physical capture, with localization and alignment before message recovery [ 20 ] . Their differing channels show why the verifier’s observation must include more than a file extension. A downloaded image and a photograph of its display present different recovery problems.
paragraphs.zh: HiDDeN 通过指定的失真层学习图像嵌入和解码 [ 19 ]。 StegaStamp 将通道扩展到物理捕获，并在消息恢复前进行定位和对齐 [ 20 ]。 它们不同的通道表明，验证器的观察必须包含的内容不能仅限于文件扩展名。 下载后的图像与其显示内容的照片会呈现不同的恢复问题。

sents.en: HiDDeN learns image embedding and decoding through specified distortion layers [ 19 ] .
sents.zh: HiDDeN 通过指定的失真层学习图像嵌入和解码 [ 19 ]。

sents.en: A downloaded image and a photograph of its display present different recovery problems.
sents.zh: 下载后的图像与其显示内容的照片会呈现不同的恢复问题。

paragraphs.en: Resolution and localization create further image-specific requirements. TrustMark learns raster embedding and extraction, scales a learned embedding residual to the cover image’s resolution, and separately studies watermark removal for re-watermarking [ 21 ] . Watermark Anything produces spatial detection scores and local message predictions, supporting recovery of multiple messages from composed images [ 22 ] . These mechanisms expose different units of evidence: a whole-image message, a detected region, or a message associated with that region. Detecting overlapping marked regions does not establish recovery of every overlapping message. The reported image results of these methods do not by themselves establish temporal consistency or complete composition history.
paragraphs.zh: 分辨率和定位带来了更多针对图像的具体要求。 TrustMark 学习栅格嵌入与提取，将学习到的嵌入残差缩放到覆盖图像的分辨率，并单独研究用于重新水印的水印移除技术 [ 21 ] 。 Watermark Anything 生成空间检测得分和局部消息预测，支持从合成图像中恢复多条消息 [ 22 ] 。 这些机制揭示了不同类型的证据单元：整张图片的消息、一个被检测到的区域，或与该区域关联的消息。 检测到重叠的标记区域，并不等同于能够恢复所有重叠的消息。 这些方法所报告的图像结果本身并不能证明时间一致性或完整的合成历史。

paragraphs.en: For video, RivaGAN uses learned embedding and extraction with attention [ 23 ] . DVMark distributes information across spatial and temporal scales [ 24 ] . ItoV adapts image watermarking by combining temporal and channel dimensions [ 25 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 对于视频，RivaGAN 使用了带有注意力机制的学习嵌入和提取方法 [ 23 ] 。 DVMark 将信息分布在空间和时间尺度上 [ 24 ] 。 ItoV 通过结合时间和通道维度来适应图像水印技术 [ 25 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Video Seal computes pixel residuals on selected frames, propagates them temporally, and aggregates extracted soft bits across frames [ 9 ] . Its discussion of artifacts during fast motion illustrates a concrete constraint: an economical embedding schedule must still respect the changing scene. Transform-domain temporal redundancy in DTCWT-SVD [ 26 ] and region selection in FlowMark [ 27 ] offer further examples of designing around video structure.
paragraphs.zh: Video Seal 在选定的帧上计算像素残差，将其沿时间方向传播，并跨帧聚合提取出的软位 [ 9 ]。 它对快速运动过程中伪影的讨论说明了一个具体限制：经济高效的嵌入方案仍然必须适应不断变化的场景。 DTCWT-SVD [ 26 ] 中的变换域时间冗余以及 FlowMark [ 27 ] 中的区域选择，为围绕视频结构进行设计提供了更多示例。

sents.zh: Video Seal 在选定的帧上计算像素残差，将其沿时间方向传播，并跨帧聚合提取出的软位 [ 9 ]。

sents.zh: 它对快速运动过程中伪影的讨论说明了一个具体限制：经济高效的嵌入方案仍然必须适应不断变化的场景。

paragraphs.en: This shared baseline is essential for a fair comparison. An animation rendered from code can receive an output watermark through the same interface as model-generated footage. What that mark supports is an assertion about the marking event or associated message. It does not, by itself, distinguish the route that produced the unmarked content. Processing the exported pixels and producing a fresh export from accessible upstream material are different operations. A claim about the first does not establish resistance to the second.
paragraphs.zh: 这种共享的基准对于公平比较至关重要。 通过代码渲染的动画可以通过与模型生成视频相同的接口接收输出水印。 该标记所支持的是对标记事件或相关信息的断言。 它本身并不能区分生成未标记内容的路径。 处理已导出的像素以及利用可访问的上游材料生成新的导出文件是两种不同的操作。 对第一种操作的声明并不能证明其能抵抗第二种操作。

sents.en: This shared baseline is essential for a fair comparison.
sents.zh: 这种共享的基准对于公平比较至关重要。

sents.zh: 通过代码渲染的动画可以通过与模型生成视频相同的接口接收输出水印。

sents.en: What that mark supports is an assertion about the marking event or associated message.
sents.zh: 该标记所支持的是对标记事件或相关信息的断言。

sents.en: It does not, by itself, distinguish the route that produced the unmarked content.
sents.zh: 它本身并不能区分生成未标记内容的路径。

sents.zh: 处理已导出的像素以及利用可访问的上游材料生成新的导出文件是两种不同的操作。

sents.zh: 对第一种操作的声明并不能证明其能抵抗第二种操作。

paragraphs.en: Internal marks can exploit generation structure. Figure 3 compares image intervention and extraction interfaces, each requiring its own verification access.
paragraphs.zh: 内部标记可以利用生成结构。 图 3 比较了图像干预和提取界面，每个界面都需要独立的验证访问。

sents.en: Internal marks can exploit generation structure.
sents.zh: 内部标记可以利用生成结构。

sents.en: Figure 3 compares image intervention and extraction interfaces, each requiring its own verification access.
sents.zh: 图 3 比较了图像干预和提取界面，每个界面都需要独立的验证访问。

paragraphs.en: Tree-Ring places a Fourier pattern in initial diffusion noise [ 28 ] . Gaussian Shading uses message-dependent Gaussian sampling with keyed randomization [ 29 ] . The studied extraction procedures of both methods use diffusion inversion and auxiliary watermark information. This differs from receiving an image and applying a standalone learned extractor. Inversion accuracy, compatible generation procedures, and access to the model belong in the mechanism description.
paragraphs.zh: Tree-Ring 在初始扩散噪声中植入傅里叶模式 [ 28 ]。 Gaussian Shading 采用与消息相关的高斯采样，并结合密钥随机化 [ 29 ]。 这两种方法所研究的提取过程均使用了扩散反演和辅助水印信息。 这与接收图像并应用独立的已学习提取器的做法不同。 反演准确性、兼容的生成过程以及对模型的访问权限都应包含在机制描述中。

sents.en: Tree-Ring places a Fourier pattern in initial diffusion noise [ 28 ] .
sents.zh: Tree-Ring 在初始扩散噪声中植入傅里叶模式 [ 28 ]。

sents.en: Gaussian Shading uses message-dependent Gaussian sampling with keyed randomization [ 29 ] .
sents.zh: Gaussian Shading 采用与消息相关的高斯采样，并结合密钥随机化 [ 29 ]。

paragraphs.en: SLICE associates separately extracted semantic factors with partitions of an initial diffusion latent [ 30 ] . It then compares reconstructed and inverted partitions during verification. This content-sensitive design also makes geometric registration part of the verification.
paragraphs.zh: SLICE 将单独提取的语义因子与初始扩散潜在空间的分区相关联 [ 30 ]。 随后，它在验证过程中比较重建和反向转换后的分区。 这种内容敏感的设计也使几何配准成为验证的一部分。

sents.en: SLICE associates separately extracted semantic factors with partitions of an initial diffusion latent [ 30 ] .
sents.zh: SLICE 将单独提取的语义因子与初始扩散潜在空间的分区相关联 [ 30 ]。

sents.en: It then compares reconstructed and inverted partitions during verification.
sents.zh: 随后，它在验证过程中比较重建和反向转换后的分区。

sents.en: This content-sensitive design also makes geometric registration part of the verification.
