paragraphs.en: For video, VideoShield encodes an encrypted template through signs of initial Gaussian noise and extracts through the corresponding video-model machinery [ 31 ] . VideoMark uses frame-wise pseudorandom-code messages and a temporal matching procedure to accommodate sequence edits [ 32 ] . Its treatment of the difficult first frame in image-to-video generation is a reminder that temporal positions can have unequal extraction quality.
paragraphs.zh: 对于视频，VideoShield 通过初始高斯噪声的标记对加密模板进行编码，并通过相应的视频模型机制进行提取 [ 31 ]。 VideoMark 使用逐帧伪随机码消息和时间匹配程序来适应序列编辑 [ 32 ]。 它在图像到视频生成过程中对困难的首帧的处理方式提醒我们，不同时间位置上的提取质量可能并不相等。

sents.en: For video, VideoShield encodes an encrypted template through signs of initial Gaussian noise and extracts through the corresponding video-model machinery [ 31 ] .
sents.zh: 对于视频，VideoShield 通过初始高斯噪声的标记对加密模板进行编码，并通过相应的视频模型机制进行提取 [ 31 ]。

sents.en: VideoMark uses frame-wise pseudorandom-code messages and a temporal matching procedure to accommodate sequence edits [ 32 ] .
sents.zh: VideoMark 使用逐帧伪随机码消息和时间匹配程序来适应序列编辑 [ 32 ]。

sents.en: Its treatment of the difficult first frame in image-to-video generation is a reminder that temporal positions can have unequal extraction quality.
sents.zh: 它在图像到视频生成过程中对困难的首帧的处理方式提醒我们，不同时间位置上的提取质量可能并不相等。

paragraphs.en: SIGMark addresses generation-time noise marking, with sequence organization designed around temporal disturbances [ 33 ] . Terms such as “blind extraction” should retain each paper’s specified access model and do not imply that a verifier needs neither a model nor a key.
paragraphs.zh: SIGMark 解决了生成时的噪声标记问题，其序列组织设计围绕时间扰动展开 [ 33 ] 。 “盲提取”等术语应保留每篇论文中指定的访问模型，并不意味着验证者既不需要模型也不需要密钥。

sents.en: SIGMark addresses generation-time noise marking, with sequence organization designed around temporal disturbances [ 33 ] .
sents.zh: SIGMark 解决了生成时的噪声标记问题，其序列组织设计围绕时间扰动展开 [ 33 ] 。

sents.en: Terms such as “blind extraction” should retain each paper’s specified access model and do not imply that a verifier needs neither a model nor a key.
sents.zh: “盲提取”等术语应保留每篇论文中指定的访问模型，并不意味着验证者既不需要模型也不需要密钥。

paragraphs.en: A second family changes the generation machinery. Stable Signature fine-tunes a latent image decoder so that a learned image extractor can recover a signature without diffusion inversion [ 34 ] . For video, LVMark modulates decoder weights [ 35 ] . Video Signature selectively fine-tunes decoder components [ 36 ] . SPDMark uses key-indexed parameter displacements [ 37 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 第二个家族改变了生成机制。 Stable Signature 对潜在图像解码器进行微调，使得学习到的图像提取器能够在没有扩散反演的情况下恢复签名 [ 34 ] 。 对于视频，LVMark 会调整解码器的权重 [ 35 ] 。 Video Signature 会选择性地对解码器组件进行微调 [ 36 ] 。 SPDMark 使用以键为索引的参数偏移量 [ 37 ] 。

sents.en: A second family changes the generation machinery.
sents.zh: 第二个家族改变了生成机制。

sents.en: Stable Signature fine-tunes a latent image decoder so that a learned image extractor can recover a signature without diffusion inversion [ 34 ] .
sents.zh: Stable Signature 对潜在图像解码器进行微调，使得学习到的图像提取器能够在没有扩散反演的情况下恢复签名 [ 34 ] 。

sents.en: For video, LVMark modulates decoder weights [ 35 ] .
sents.zh: 对于视频，LVMark 会调整解码器的权重 [ 35 ] 。

sents.en: Video Signature selectively fine-tunes decoder components [ 36 ] .
sents.zh: Video Signature 会选择性地对解码器组件进行微调 [ 36 ] 。

sents.en: SPDMark uses key-indexed parameter displacements [ 37 ] .
sents.zh: SPDMark 使用以键为索引的参数偏移量 [ 37 ] 。

paragraphs.en: These methods make different commitments about producer control, output variation, and verifier resources. A conventional vector rasterizer does not automatically expose an intervention of this kind. Conversely, a program can call a marked neural decoder and inherit its output as an asset. The useful comparison is thus between accessible components in the actual pipeline, not between product labels. Reported processing robustness and distribution-preservation properties remain scoped to the individual methods and their assumptions.
paragraphs.zh: 这些方法对生产者控制、输出变化以及验证器资源做出了不同的承诺。 传统的矢量光栅化器不会自动暴露此类干预。 相反，一个程序可以调用带有标记的神经解码器，并将其输出作为资产继承下来。 因此，有意义的比较应基于实际流程中可访问的组件，而非产品标签之间的比较。 所报告的处理鲁棒性和分布保持特性仍然局限于各个方法及其假设。

sents.en: These methods make different commitments about producer control, output variation, and verifier resources.
sents.zh: 这些方法对生产者控制、输出变化以及验证器资源做出了不同的承诺。

sents.en: A conventional vector rasterizer does not automatically expose an intervention of this kind.
sents.zh: 传统的矢量光栅化器不会自动暴露此类干预。

sents.en: Conversely, a program can call a marked neural decoder and inherit its output as an asset.
sents.zh: 相反，一个程序可以调用带有标记的神经解码器，并将其输出作为资产继承下来。

sents.en: The useful comparison is thus between accessible components in the actual pipeline, not between product labels.
sents.zh: 因此，有意义的比较应基于实际流程中可访问的组件，而非产品标签之间的比较。

sents.en: Reported processing robustness and distribution-preservation properties remain scoped to the individual methods and their assumptions.
sents.zh: 所报告的处理鲁棒性和分布保持特性仍然局限于各个方法及其假设。

paragraphs.en: Source watermarking has a well-defined observation space of its own. SWEET places token-level marks at selected high-entropy positions [ 38 ] . STONE gates marking by syntax category [ 39 ] . AST-guided code watermarking learns token placement with structural guidance [ 40 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 源水印技术拥有自身明确定义的观察空间。 SWEET 在选定的高熵位置放置令牌级标记 [ 38 ] 。 STONE 根据语法类别对标记进行限制 [ 39 ] 。 AST 引导的代码水印技术通过结构指导学习令牌放置方式 [ 40 ] 。

sents.en: Source watermarking has a well-defined observation space of its own.
sents.zh: 源水印技术拥有自身明确定义的观察空间。

sents.en: SWEET places token-level marks at selected high-entropy positions [ 38 ] .
sents.zh: SWEET 在选定的高熵位置放置令牌级标记 [ 38 ] 。

sents.en: STONE gates marking by syntax category [ 39 ] .
sents.zh: STONE 根据语法类别对标记进行限制 [ 39 ] 。

sents.en: AST-guided code watermarking learns token placement with structural guidance [ 40 ] .
sents.zh: AST 引导的代码水印技术通过结构指导学习令牌放置方式 [ 40 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Transformation-based approaches instead encode through choices among source representations. ACW uses transformations such as refactoring and reordering [ 41 ] . SrcMarker combines structural transformations with variable substitutions [ 10 ] . These mechanisms identify information in suspect code. Readers should not take their utility and attack studies as guarantees that one can extract the same information from executed frames.
paragraphs.zh: 基于转换的方法则通过在不同源表示之间进行选择来进行编码。 ACW 使用了诸如重构和重排序之类的转换 [ 41 ] 。 SrcMarker 将结构转换与变量替换相结合 [ 10 ] 。 这些机制能够识别可疑代码中的信息。 读者不应将这些实用性和攻击研究视为能够从已执行帧中提取相同信息的保证。

sents.en: Transformation-based approaches instead encode through choices among source representations.
sents.zh: 基于转换的方法则通过在不同源表示之间进行选择来进行编码。

sents.en: ACW uses transformations such as refactoring and reordering [ 41 ] .
sents.zh: ACW 使用了诸如重构和重排序之类的转换 [ 41 ] 。

sents.en: SrcMarker combines structural transformations with variable substitutions [ 10 ] .
sents.zh: SrcMarker 将结构转换与变量替换相结合 [ 10 ] 。

sents.en: These mechanisms identify information in suspect code.
sents.zh: 这些机制能够识别可疑代码中的信息。

sents.en: Readers should not take their utility and attack studies as guarantees that one can extract the same information from executed frames.
sents.zh: 读者不应将这些实用性和攻击研究视为能够从已执行帧中提取相同信息的保证。

paragraphs.en: For a drawing program, if the declared execution and observation rules ignore an allowed identifier change, that change leaves the observed image unchanged. A pixel-only verifier gains no distinguishing signal from that change at fixed inputs and environment. This statement concerns the specified observation. A source inspector, a metadata reader, or an execution monitor may still distinguish the files. Reflection, external state, and timing prevent us from declaring arbitrary source transformations render-preserving without examining the interpreter.
paragraphs.zh: 对于绘图程序而言，如果声明的执行和观察规则忽略了一个允许的标识符变更，那么该变更不会改变所观察到的图像。 在输入和环境固定的情况下，仅基于像素的验证器无法从该变更中获得任何区分信号。 此陈述涉及指定的观察方式。 源文件检查器、元数据读取器或执行监控器可能仍然能够区分这些文件。 反射、外部状态和计时因素使我们无法在不检查解释器的情况下，断言任意的源文件转换都能保持渲染结果不变。

sents.en: For a drawing program, if the declared execution and observation rules ignore an allowed identifier change, that change leaves the observed image unchanged.
sents.zh: 对于绘图程序而言，如果声明的执行和观察规则忽略了一个允许的标识符变更，那么该变更不会改变所观察到的图像。

sents.en: A pixel-only verifier gains no distinguishing signal from that change at fixed inputs and environment.
sents.zh: 在输入和环境固定的情况下，仅基于像素的验证器无法从该变更中获得任何区分信号。

sents.en: This statement concerns the specified observation.
sents.zh: 此陈述涉及指定的观察方式。

sents.en: A source inspector, a metadata reader, or an execution monitor may still distinguish the files.
sents.zh: 源文件检查器、元数据读取器或执行监控器可能仍然能够区分这些文件。

sents.en: Reflection, external state, and timing prevent us from declaring arbitrary source transformations render-preserving without examining the interpreter.
sents.zh: 反射、外部状态和计时因素使我们无法在不检查解释器的情况下，断言任意的源文件转换都能保持渲染结果不变。

paragraphs.en: Source interventions can instead affect visible parameters. A program may select a line style, texture, layout, or motion pattern that carries information. Then the central constraint becomes task preservation. The change must preserve the chart’s values, the explanation’s meaning, or the animation’s required events. That possibility requires its own encoding and verification design. Existing code-token detection supplies useful precedents for source control and attack access, but does not settle this downstream visual problem.
paragraphs.zh: 源干预反而可能影响可见的参数。 一个程序可以选择承载信息的线条样式、纹理、布局或运动模式。 此时，核心约束便转变为任务保留。 这种变化必须保留图表中的数值、解释中的含义，或动画中必需的事件。 这种可能性需要独立的编码与验证设计。 现有的代码令牌检测为源控制和攻击访问提供了有用的先例，但并未解决这一下游的视觉问题。

sents.en: Source interventions can instead affect visible parameters.
sents.zh: 源干预反而可能影响可见的参数。

sents.en: A program may select a line style, texture, layout, or motion pattern that carries information.
sents.zh: 一个程序可以选择承载信息的线条样式、纹理、布局或运动模式。

sents.en: Then the central constraint becomes task preservation.
sents.zh: 此时，核心约束便转变为任务保留。

sents.en: The change must preserve the chart’s values, the explanation’s meaning, or the animation’s required events.
sents.zh: 这种变化必须保留图表中的数值、解释中的含义，或动画中必需的事件。

sents.en: That possibility requires its own encoding and verification design.
sents.zh: 这种可能性需要独立的编码与验证设计。

sents.en: Existing code-token detection supplies useful precedents for source control and attack access, but does not settle this downstream visual problem.
sents.zh: 现有的代码令牌检测为源控制和攻击访问提供了有用的先例，但并未解决这一下游的视觉问题。

paragraphs.en: Rendering can transmit a mark deliberately placed in an asset. CopyRNeRF modifies a radiance field’s color representation and trains a decoder on rendered image patches [ 11 ] . WateRF likewise studies marks recovered from rendered views of a modified representation [ 42 ] . These are concrete precedents for a signal crossing the representation-to-image boundary. These methods permit visual changes and optimize rendering quality, so they do not conflict with the elementary observation (Section 2.4 ) that exact preservation of the verifier’s input leaves no new signal.
paragraphs.zh: 渲染可以传递有意放置在资产中的标记。 CopyRNeRF 修改了辐射场的颜色表示，并在渲染出的图像块上训练解码器 [ 11 ] 。 WateRF 同样研究了从修改后的表示的渲染视图中恢复出的标记 [ 42 ] 。 这些是信号跨越表示到图像边界的明确先例。 这些方法允许进行视觉上的改变并优化渲染质量，因此它们与基本观察（第 2.4 节）并不冲突：即精确保留验证器的输入不会留下任何新信号。

sents.en: Rendering can transmit a mark deliberately placed in an asset.
sents.zh: 渲染可以传递有意放置在资产中的标记。

sents.en: CopyRNeRF modifies a radiance field’s color representation and trains a decoder on rendered image patches [ 11 ] .
sents.zh: CopyRNeRF 修改了辐射场的颜色表示，并在渲染出的图像块上训练解码器 [ 11 ] 。

sents.en: WateRF likewise studies marks recovered from rendered views of a modified representation [ 42 ] .
sents.zh: WateRF 同样研究了从修改后的表示的渲染视图中恢复出的标记 [ 42 ] 。

sents.en: These are concrete precedents for a signal crossing the representation-to-image boundary.
sents.zh: 这些是信号跨越表示到图像边界的明确先例。

sents.en: These methods permit visual changes and optimize rendering quality, so they do not conflict with the elementary observation (Section 2.4 ) that exact preservation of the verifier’s input leaves no new signal.
sents.zh: 这些方法允许进行视觉上的改变并优化渲染质量，因此它们与基本观察（第 2.4 节）并不冲突：即精确保留验证器的输入不会留下任何新信号。

paragraphs.en: GaussianMarker makes the observation distinction especially explicit by using separate decoders for rendered images and Gaussian parameters [ 43 ] . The parameter decoder has information unavailable to an ordinary image viewer. 3D-GSW [ 44 ] optimizes a modified Gaussian representation through rendering. A fixed image-message decoder reads a frequency subband of the resulting view. These methods concern marked representations and selected transformations and do not authenticate every program that later loads the representation.
paragraphs.zh: GaussianMarker 通过为渲染图像和高斯参数分别使用独立的解码器，使这种观察上的区分变得尤为明确 [ 43 ]。 参数解码器拥有普通图像查看器无法获取的信息。3D-GSW [ 44 ] 通过渲染来优化一种改进的高斯表示。 一个固定的图像消息解码器会读取最终视图的一个频率子带。 这些方法涉及标记化的表示和特定的变换，并不会验证后续加载该表示的任何程序。

sents.en: GaussianMarker makes the observation distinction especially explicit by using separate decoders for rendered images and Gaussian parameters [ 43 ] .
sents.zh: GaussianMarker 通过为渲染图像和高斯参数分别使用独立的解码器，使这种观察上的区分变得尤为明确 [ 43 ]。

sents.en: The parameter decoder has information unavailable to an ordinary image viewer. 3D-GSW [ 44 ] optimizes a modified Gaussian representation through rendering.
sents.zh: 参数解码器拥有普通图像查看器无法获取的信息。3D-GSW [ 44 ] 通过渲染来优化一种改进的高斯表示。

sents.en: A fixed image-message decoder reads a frequency subband of the resulting view.
sents.zh: 一个固定的图像消息解码器会读取最终视图的一个频率子带。

sents.en: These methods concern marked representations and selected transformations and do not authenticate every program that later loads the representation.
sents.zh: 这些方法涉及标记化的表示和特定的变换，并不会验证后续加载该表示的任何程序。

paragraphs.en: An asset can also cross into another generator. LoT-Pass studies source-image marks passing through image-to-video generation [ 45 ] . The wider implication for hybrid pipelines is precise: each downstream operation defines a further transmission channel. Rendering the same marked asset again can retain its signal. Replacing it with clean material, rebuilding the scene, or bypassing an added representation component is a different attacker capability. A provenance assertion should name the marked contribution and the allowed operations on it.
paragraphs.zh: 一个资产也可以进入另一个生成器。 LoT-Pass 研究了源图像标记在图像到视频生成过程中的传递 [ 45 ] 。 这对混合流程的更广泛影响非常明确：每个下游操作都定义了一个新的传输通道。 再次渲染同一个带有标记的资产可以保留其信号。 用干净素材替换它、重建场景或绕过新增的表现组件，是攻击者的另一种能力。 一个来源声明应指明被标记的贡献部分以及允许对其执行的操作。

sents.en: An asset can also cross into another generator.
sents.zh: 一个资产也可以进入另一个生成器。

sents.en: LoT-Pass studies source-image marks passing through image-to-video generation [ 45 ] .
sents.zh: LoT-Pass 研究了源图像标记在图像到视频生成过程中的传递 [ 45 ] 。

sents.en: The wider implication for hybrid pipelines is precise: each downstream operation defines a further transmission channel.
sents.zh: 这对混合流程的更广泛影响非常明确：每个下游操作都定义了一个新的传输通道。

sents.en: Rendering the same marked asset again can retain its signal.
sents.zh: 再次渲染同一个带有标记的资产可以保留其信号。

sents.en: Replacing it with clean material, rebuilding the scene, or bypassing an added representation component is a different attacker capability.
sents.zh: 用干净素材替换它、重建场景或绕过新增的表现组件，是攻击者的另一种能力。

sents.en: A provenance assertion should name the marked contribution and the allowed operations on it.
sents.zh: 一个来源声明应指明被标记的贡献部分以及允许对其执行的操作。

paragraphs.en: The renderer can be an intervention point and an evidence producer. The inspected Remotion server-rendering path separates composition selection, evaluation at a frame index, frame capture, and media encoding [ 13 , 46 , 47 , 48 ] . These boundaries identify places where a system designer could modify emitted pixels or record an execution event. They are observations about the workflow, not a claim that Remotion implements such a watermark. Its browser-side rendering path has a different implementation, which reinforces the need to declare the actual backend [ 14 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 渲染器可以是一个干预点，也可以是一个证据生成器。 受检查的 Remotion 服务器端渲染流程将组合选择、帧索引处的评估、帧捕获和媒体编码分离开来 [ 13 , 46 , 47 , 48 ] 。 这些边界标识了系统设计师可以修改输出像素或记录执行事件的位置。 这些是对工作流程的观察，而非声称 Remotion 实现了此类水印。 其浏览器端的渲染流程采用了不同的实现方式，这进一步凸显了声明实际后端技术的必要性 [ 14 ] 。

sents.en: The renderer can be an intervention point and an evidence producer.
sents.zh: 渲染器可以是一个干预点，也可以是一个证据生成器。

sents.en: The inspected Remotion server-rendering path separates composition selection, evaluation at a frame index, frame capture, and media encoding [ 13 , 46 , 47 , 48 ] .
sents.zh: 受检查的 Remotion 服务器端渲染流程将组合选择、帧索引处的评估、帧捕获和媒体编码分离开来 [ 13 , 46 , 47 , 48 ] 。

sents.en: These boundaries identify places where a system designer could modify emitted pixels or record an execution event.
sents.zh: 这些边界标识了系统设计师可以修改输出像素或记录执行事件的位置。

sents.en: They are observations about the workflow, not a claim that Remotion implements such a watermark.
sents.zh: 这些是对工作流程的观察，而非声称 Remotion 实现了此类水印。

sents.en: Its browser-side rendering path has a different implementation, which reinforces the need to declare the actual backend [ 14 ] .
sents.zh: 其浏览器端的渲染流程采用了不同的实现方式，这进一步凸显了声明实际后端技术的必要性 [ 14 ] 。

paragraphs.en: A managed renderer could apply a keyed pixel mark, issue a signed receipt, or attach a content credential. These mechanisms produce different observations: decoded pixels, a separately retained record, and structured file-associated evidence. C2PA provides a framework for signed provenance assertions and content binding (Appendix D ) [ 12 ] . Reading a credential and recovering a pixel message remain distinct verification operations. Image/video generation services expose analogous service and export boundaries even when no user-authored program takes part.
paragraphs.zh: 受管理的渲染器可以应用带键的像素标记、签发带签名的收据，或附加内容凭证。 这些机制会产生不同的观察结果：解码后的像素、单独保留的记录以及与文件关联的结构化证据。 C2PA 为带签名的来源声明和内容绑定提供了框架（附录 D）[12]。 读取凭证和恢复像素消息仍然是两个独立的验证操作。 即使没有用户编写的程序参与，图像/视频生成服务也会暴露类似的服务和导出边界。

sents.en: A managed renderer could apply a keyed pixel mark, issue a signed receipt, or attach a content credential.
sents.zh: 受管理的渲染器可以应用带键的像素标记、签发带签名的收据，或附加内容凭证。

sents.en: These mechanisms produce different observations: decoded pixels, a separately retained record, and structured file-associated evidence.
sents.zh: 这些机制会产生不同的观察结果：解码后的像素、单独保留的记录以及与文件关联的结构化证据。

sents.en: C2PA provides a framework for signed provenance assertions and content binding (Appendix D ) [ 12 ] .
sents.zh: C2PA 为带签名的来源声明和内容绑定提供了框架（附录 D）[12]。

sents.en: Reading a credential and recovering a pixel message remain distinct verification operations.
sents.zh: 读取凭证和恢复像素消息仍然是两个独立的验证操作。

sents.en: Image/video generation services expose analogous service and export boundaries even when no user-authored program takes part.
sents.zh: 即使没有用户编写的程序参与，图像/视频生成服务也会暴露类似的服务和导出边界。

paragraphs.en: The supported assertion must follow the intervention. A renderer’s evidence may establish that it processed an artifact under stated conditions. Establishing who authored the input, which assets contributed, or whether the producer invoked a particular model requires additional bindings. If callers can export through another renderer, the availability of that bypass is part of the attacker model.
paragraphs.zh: 受支持的断言必须紧随干预之后。 渲染器的证据可以证明，它在规定的条件下处理了某个工件。 要确定输入的作者、哪些资产做出了贡献，或者生产者是否调用了特定模型，需要额外的绑定。 如果调用者可以通过另一个渲染器进行导出，那么这种旁路机制的可用性就属于攻击者模型的一部分。

sents.en: The supported assertion must follow the intervention.
sents.zh: 受支持的断言必须紧随干预之后。

sents.en: A renderer’s evidence may establish that it processed an artifact under stated conditions.
sents.zh: 渲染器的证据可以证明，它在规定的条件下处理了某个工件。

sents.en: Establishing who authored the input, which assets contributed, or whether the producer invoked a particular model requires additional bindings.
sents.zh: 要确定输入的作者、哪些资产做出了贡献，或者生产者是否调用了特定模型，需要额外的绑定。

sents.en: If callers can export through another renderer, the availability of that bypass is part of the attacker model.
sents.zh: 如果调用者可以通过另一个渲染器进行导出，那么这种旁路机制的可用性就属于攻击者模型的一部分。

paragraphs.en: None of these three sources of evidence establishes complete authorship. A service may add no mark, or callers may bypass the service, and someone may copy a marked component into another composition. VideoMarkBench separates removal, forgery, and attacker access [ 49 ] . Application constraints matter too: a signal acceptable in a photograph may be unacceptable in a scientific plot or timed explanation.
paragraphs.zh: 这三种证据来源中的任何一种都无法完全确立作者身份。 服务可能不添加任何标记，或者调用者可能绕过该服务，并且有人可能会将带有标记的组件复制到另一个作品中。 VideoMarkBench 将移除、伪造和攻击者访问区分开来 [ 49 ] 。 应用限制也很重要：在照片中可接受的信号，在科学图表或定时说明中可能不可接受。

sents.en: None of these three sources of evidence establishes complete authorship.
sents.zh: 这三种证据来源中的任何一种都无法完全确立作者身份。

sents.en: A service may add no mark, or callers may bypass the service, and someone may copy a marked component into another composition.
sents.zh: 服务可能不添加任何标记，或者调用者可能绕过该服务，并且有人可能会将带有标记的组件复制到另一个作品中。

sents.en: VideoMarkBench separates removal, forgery, and attacker access [ 49 ] .
sents.zh: VideoMarkBench 将移除、伪造和攻击者访问区分开来 [ 49 ] 。

sents.en: Application constraints matter too: a signal acceptable in a photograph may be unacceptable in a scientific plot or timed explanation.
sents.zh: 应用限制也很重要：在照片中可接受的信号，在科学图表或定时说明中可能不可接受。

paragraphs.en: Photographs, plots, SVG diagrams, and narrated animations allow different changes and expose different verifier observations. The following examples turn production-stage comparisons into application-specific research settings; they are not experimental findings.
paragraphs.zh: 照片、情节图、SVG 图表和带旁白的动画允许进行不同的更改，并展示验证器的不同观察结果。 以下示例将生产阶段的比较转化为特定于应用的研究设置；它们并非实验性发现。

sents.en: Photographs, plots, SVG diagrams, and narrated animations allow different changes and expose different verifier observations.
sents.zh: 照片、情节图、SVG 图表和带旁白的动画允许进行不同的更改，并展示验证器的不同观察结果。

sents.en: The following examples turn production-stage comparisons into application-specific research settings; they are not experimental findings.
sents.zh: 以下示例将生产阶段的比较转化为特定于应用的研究设置；它们并非实验性发现。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 makes these settings concrete with selected video frames and static graphics. Media from code-based rendering can incorporate elaborate scenes and imported assets, and an image model can generate a diagram. Thus visual style does not define the workflow.
paragraphs.zh: 图 4 通过选定的视频帧和静态图形将这些设置具体化。 基于代码渲染的媒体可以包含复杂的场景和导入的资产，而图像模型则可以生成图表。 因此，视觉风格并不定义工作流程。

sents.en: Figure 4 makes these settings concrete with selected video frames and static graphics.
sents.zh: 图 4 通过选定的视频帧和静态图形将这些设置具体化。

sents.en: Media from code-based rendering can incorporate elaborate scenes and imported assets, and an image model can generate a diagram.
sents.zh: 基于代码渲染的媒体可以包含复杂的场景和导入的资产，而图像模型则可以生成图表。

sents.en: Thus visual style does not define the workflow.
sents.zh: 因此，视觉风格并不定义工作流程。

paragraphs.en: Editable source, then local rasterization
paragraphs.zh: 可编辑源，然后进行本地光栅化

paragraphs.en: Four conditions shape a study of generated images and video: intended use, audio (for narrated video), verifier access, and the assertion under test. Evaluate visual fidelity and provenance at the intended use. For a generated illustration, a task might allow small texture changes while requiring the depicted objects and their relations to remain intact. Video adds continuity, event order, and timing.
paragraphs.zh: 生成图像和视频的研究受四个条件影响：预期用途、音频（用于旁白视频）、验证器访问权限以及待测试的断言。 在预期使用场景下评估视觉保真度和来源信息。 对于生成的插图，某项任务可能允许微小的纹理变化，但要求所描绘的对象及其关系保持不变。 视频增加了连续性、事件顺序和时间维度。

sents.en: Four conditions shape a study of generated images and video: intended use, audio (for narrated video), verifier access, and the assertion under test.
sents.zh: 生成图像和视频的研究受四个条件影响：预期用途、音频（用于旁白视频）、验证器访问权限以及待测试的断言。

sents.en: Evaluate visual fidelity and provenance at the intended use.
sents.zh: 在预期使用场景下评估视觉保真度和来源信息。

sents.en: For a generated illustration, a task might allow small texture changes while requiring the depicted objects and their relations to remain intact.
sents.zh: 对于生成的插图，某项任务可能允许微小的纹理变化，但要求所描绘的对象及其关系保持不变。

sents.en: Video adds continuity, event order, and timing.
sents.zh: 视频增加了连续性、事件顺序和时间维度。

paragraphs.en: These requirements explain why image-watermark extraction alone cannot establish video suitability. A signal that is unobtrusive in individual frames may vary distractingly over time, and a detector may rely on frames removed during editing. The spatial and temporal designs of Video Seal and VideoMark illustrate different responses to these concerns [ 9 , 32 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 这些要求解释了为何仅通过提取图像水印无法确定视频的适宜性。 在单帧画面中并不突兀的信号，可能会随时间推移而变得令人分心，而且检测器可能依赖剪辑过程中被移除的帧。 Video Seal 和 VideoMark 的空间与时间设计展示了针对这些问题的不同应对方案 [ 9 , 32 ] 。

sents.en: These requirements explain why image-watermark extraction alone cannot establish video suitability.
sents.zh: 这些要求解释了为何仅通过提取图像水印无法确定视频的适宜性。

sents.en: A signal that is unobtrusive in individual frames may vary distractingly over time, and a detector may rely on frames removed during editing.
sents.zh: 在单帧画面中并不突兀的信号，可能会随时间推移而变得令人分心，而且检测器可能依赖剪辑过程中被移除的帧。

sents.en: The spatial and temporal designs of Video Seal and VideoMark illustrate different responses to these concerns [ 9 , 32 ] .
sents.zh: Video Seal 和 VideoMark 的空间与时间设计展示了针对这些问题的不同应对方案 [ 9 , 32 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Narrated video adds an audio observation channel. LAVA studies alignment, channel-reliability gating, and fusion of semi-fragile audio–visual watermark scores [ 55 ] . Its evaluated offset selection uses an oracle; label-free alignment and calibrated fusion under joint channel failure remain deployment questions.
paragraphs.zh: 旁白视频增加了一个音频观察通道。 LAVA 研究了对齐、通道可靠性门控以及半脆弱音视频水印分数的融合 [ 55 ] 。 其评估的偏移量选择使用了神谕；在联合通道故障下的无标签对齐和校准融合仍属于部署问题。

sents.en: Narrated video adds an audio observation channel.
sents.zh: 旁白视频增加了一个音频观察通道。

sents.en: LAVA studies alignment, channel-reliability gating, and fusion of semi-fragile audio–visual watermark scores [ 55 ] .
sents.zh: LAVA 研究了对齐、通道可靠性门控以及半脆弱音视频水印分数的融合 [ 55 ] 。

sents.en: Its evaluated offset selection uses an oracle; label-free alignment and calibrated fusion under joint channel failure remain deployment questions.
sents.zh: 其评估的偏移量选择使用了神谕；在联合通道故障下的无标签对齐和校准融合仍属于部署问题。

paragraphs.en: The verifier’s access also changes the problem. A recipient with a downloaded clip can aggregate frame evidence, but someone with one screenshot cannot use temporal redundancy. A model-owning verifier may attempt inversion, but a third party may possess only a learned decoder and the received pixels.
paragraphs.zh: 验证者的访问权限也会改变问题本身。 拥有已下载片段的接收者可以聚合帧证据，但仅有一张截图的人则无法利用时间冗余。 拥有模型的验证者可能会尝试反推，但第三方可能只掌握一个训练好的解码器和接收到的像素数据。

sents.en: The verifier’s access also changes the problem.
sents.zh: 验证者的访问权限也会改变问题本身。

sents.en: A recipient with a downloaded clip can aggregate frame evidence, but someone with one screenshot cannot use temporal redundancy.
sents.zh: 拥有已下载片段的接收者可以聚合帧证据，但仅有一张截图的人则无法利用时间冗余。

sents.en: A model-owning verifier may attempt inversion, but a third party may possess only a learned decoder and the received pixels.
sents.zh: 拥有模型的验证者可能会尝试反推，但第三方可能只掌握一个训练好的解码器和接收到的像素数据。

paragraphs.en: Passive inference of synthetic footage is distinct from message recovery, the estimation of an embedded message. GenVidBench and UNITE study declared synthetic-video detection populations [ 56 , 57 ] . Their labels do not automatically resolve whether an LLM authored a program behind another clip. Declare the assertion under test before choosing the detector: a visible generated contribution, a generation event, or an issuer association.
paragraphs.zh: 对合成视频片段的被动推断与消息恢复（即对嵌入消息的估计）有所不同。 GenVidBench 和 UNITE 研究声明了合成视频检测数据集 [56, 57]。 它们的标签并不能自动确定某个 LLM 是否在其他片段背后编写了程序。 在选择检测器之前，先声明待测试的断言：一个可见的生成贡献、一个生成事件或一个发布者关联。

sents.en: Passive inference of synthetic footage is distinct from message recovery, the estimation of an embedded message.
sents.zh: 对合成视频片段的被动推断与消息恢复（即对嵌入消息的估计）有所不同。

sents.en: GenVidBench and UNITE study declared synthetic-video detection populations [ 56 , 57 ] .
sents.zh: GenVidBench 和 UNITE 研究声明了合成视频检测数据集 [56, 57]。

sents.en: Their labels do not automatically resolve whether an LLM authored a program behind another clip.
sents.zh: 它们的标签并不能自动确定某个 LLM 是否在其他片段背后编写了程序。

sents.en: Declare the assertion under test before choosing the detector: a visible generated contribution, a generation event, or an issuer association.
sents.zh: 在选择检测器之前，先声明待测试的断言：一个可见的生成贡献、一个生成事件或一个发布者关联。

paragraphs.en: A visually small change can be a substantive error in an explanatory graphic. Consider a plot teaching the relation between position and velocity. Moving a data point, changing an axis label, or shifting a highlighted event may alter the lesson even when the image remains attractive. A task specification could instead allow changes to a background pattern or line decoration while fixing values, units, labels, and the intended correspondence. Whether those freedoms support reliable marking is an application-specific question. Perceptual similarity alone does not define success.
paragraphs.zh: 在解释性图表中，一个看似微小的视觉变化可能构成实质性的错误。 考虑一个用于教授位置与速度之间关系的图表。 移动数据点、更改坐标轴标签或调整高亮事件的位置，即使图像仍然美观，也可能改变其所传达的结论。 任务规范也可以允许更改背景图案或线条装饰，同时固定数值、单位、标签以及预期的对应关系。 这些自由度是否有助于实现可靠的标注，是一个取决于具体应用的问题。 仅凭感知上的相似性并不能定义成功。

sents.en: A visually small change can be a substantive error in an explanatory graphic.
sents.zh: 在解释性图表中，一个看似微小的视觉变化可能构成实质性的错误。

sents.en: Consider a plot teaching the relation between position and velocity.
sents.zh: 考虑一个用于教授位置与速度之间关系的图表。

sents.en: Moving a data point, changing an axis label, or shifting a highlighted event may alter the lesson even when the image remains attractive.
sents.zh: 移动数据点、更改坐标轴标签或调整高亮事件的位置，即使图像仍然美观，也可能改变其所传达的结论。

sents.en: A task specification could instead allow changes to a background pattern or line decoration while fixing values, units, labels, and the intended correspondence.
sents.zh: 任务规范也可以允许更改背景图案或线条装饰，同时固定数值、单位、标签以及预期的对应关系。

sents.en: Whether those freedoms support reliable marking is an application-specific question.
sents.zh: 这些自由度是否有助于实现可靠的标注，是一个取决于具体应用的问题。

sents.en: Perceptual similarity alone does not define success.
sents.zh: 仅凭感知上的相似性并不能定义成功。

paragraphs.en: Graphics tools expose several observation interfaces. Matplotlib documents both raster and vector export formats [ 58 ] . Claude’s documented custom-visuals feature constructs HTML-based visuals and supports SVG or HTML downloads [ 7 ] ; Section 5 gives the documentation details. A verifier that receives such source material can inspect its structure and text, but one that receives a raster export sees the rendered effect. SVG’s document and rendering structures are distinct. Its supported features make the grammar, resources, and rendering environment relevant to any precise equivalence claim [ 59 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 图形工具提供了多种观察接口。 Matplotlib 文档中同时介绍了光栅和矢量导出格式 [ 58 ] 。 Claude 文档中记载的自定义视觉功能可构建基于 HTML 的视觉内容，并支持 SVG 或 HTML 下载 [ 7 ]；第 5 节提供了相关文档细节。 接收此类源材料的验证器可以检查其结构和文本，而接收光栅导出结果的验证器则只能看到渲染后的效果。 SVG 的文档结构与渲染结构是相互独立的。 其支持的功能使得语法、资源和渲染环境对于任何精确的等价性主张都具有重要意义 [ 59 ] 。

sents.en: Graphics tools expose several observation interfaces.
sents.zh: 图形工具提供了多种观察接口。

sents.en: Matplotlib documents both raster and vector export formats [ 58 ] .
sents.zh: Matplotlib 文档中同时介绍了光栅和矢量导出格式 [ 58 ] 。

sents.en: Claude’s documented custom-visuals feature constructs HTML-based visuals and supports SVG or HTML downloads [ 7 ] ; Section 5 gives the documentation details.
sents.zh: Claude 文档中记载的自定义视觉功能可构建基于 HTML 的视觉内容，并支持 SVG 或 HTML 下载 [ 7 ]；第 5 节提供了相关文档细节。

sents.en: A verifier that receives such source material can inspect its structure and text, but one that receives a raster export sees the rendered effect.
sents.zh: 接收此类源材料的验证器可以检查其结构和文本，而接收光栅导出结果的验证器则只能看到渲染后的效果。

sents.en: SVG’s document and rendering structures are distinct.
sents.zh: SVG 的文档结构与渲染结构是相互独立的。

sents.en: Its supported features make the grammar, resources, and rendering environment relevant to any precise equivalence claim [ 59 ] .
sents.zh: 其支持的功能使得语法、资源和渲染环境对于任何精确的等价性主张都具有重要意义 [ 59 ] 。

paragraphs.en: For example, a marker in an ignored SVG comment could remain in the downloaded source and disappear from a screenshot. A marker encoded in rendered color choices has a path to that screenshot, subject to the capture and processing channel. Thus re-exporting the same marked description differs from recreating the graphic from its numerical data. A task check of the plot’s truth and a watermark detector’s check of a signal need explicit, potentially different acceptance rules.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，被忽略的 SVG 注释中的标记可能仍保留在下载的来源文件中，但在截图中却会消失。 编码于渲染颜色选择中的标记与截图存在关联路径，但该路径受截图采集和处理渠道的影响。 因此，重新导出相同的带标记描述，与根据数值数据重新创建图形是不同的操作。 对图表真实性的任务检查与水印检测器对信号的检查，需要明确且可能不同的接受规则。

sents.en: For example, a marker in an ignored SVG comment could remain in the downloaded source and disappear from a screenshot.
sents.zh: 例如，被忽略的 SVG 注释中的标记可能仍保留在下载的来源文件中，但在截图中却会消失。

sents.en: A marker encoded in rendered color choices has a path to that screenshot, subject to the capture and processing channel.
sents.zh: 编码于渲染颜色选择中的标记与截图存在关联路径，但该路径受截图采集和处理渠道的影响。

sents.en: Thus re-exporting the same marked description differs from recreating the graphic from its numerical data.
sents.zh: 因此，重新导出相同的带标记描述，与根据数值数据重新创建图形是不同的操作。

sents.en: A task check of the plot’s truth and a watermark detector’s check of a signal need explicit, potentially different acceptance rules.
sents.zh: 对图表真实性的任务检查与水印检测器对信号的检查，需要明确且可能不同的接受规则。

paragraphs.en: A rendered plot can thus receive a raster watermark even when its source is ordinary SVG or plotting code. That choice protects the marked export under a specified image channel. A fresh render from an unmarked source bypasses that postprocessing stage (Section 3 ). Conversely, a source-level mark that changes no observed pixels gives a pixel-only verifier no new signal. Designing a mark that crosses this boundary requires selecting allowed visible changes and the task they must preserve.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，即使其来源是普通的 SVG 或绘图代码，渲染后的图表仍然可以接收栅格水印。 该选择在指定的图像通道下保护了带有标记的导出文件。 从无标记来源生成的新渲染结果会跳过该后处理阶段（第 3 节）。 相反，如果在源级别添加的标记不会改变任何可观察到的像素，那么仅基于像素的验证器将无法获得任何新信号。 要设计一个能够跨越这一边界的标记，需要选择允许出现的可见变化以及这些变化必须保留的任务。

sents.en: A rendered plot can thus receive a raster watermark even when its source is ordinary SVG or plotting code.
sents.zh: 因此，即使其来源是普通的 SVG 或绘图代码，渲染后的图表仍然可以接收栅格水印。

sents.en: That choice protects the marked export under a specified image channel.
sents.zh: 该选择在指定的图像通道下保护了带有标记的导出文件。

sents.en: A fresh render from an unmarked source bypasses that postprocessing stage (Section 3 ).
sents.zh: 从无标记来源生成的新渲染结果会跳过该后处理阶段（第 3 节）。

sents.en: Conversely, a source-level mark that changes no observed pixels gives a pixel-only verifier no new signal.
sents.zh: 相反，如果在源级别添加的标记不会改变任何可观察到的像素，那么仅基于像素的验证器将无法获得任何新信号。

sents.en: Designing a mark that crosses this boundary requires selecting allowed visible changes and the task they must preserve.
sents.zh: 要设计一个能够跨越这一边界的标记，需要选择允许出现的可见变化以及这些变化必须保留的任务。

paragraphs.en: Exported video may conceal its construction history. Figure 5 separates pixel processing, asset reuse, and clean-source export. In Claude Code–Remotion workflows, the agent edits a project and the renderer produces media [ 3 , 4 ] . Section 5 gives the details. Project access exposes code, assets, and configuration that a clip-only viewer lacks. Different histories can produce identical depicted events, so source-mark recovery and animation attribution are separate questions.
paragraphs.zh: 导出的视频可能隐藏其构建历史。 图 5 将像素处理、资源重用和纯净源导出区分开来。 在 Claude Code–Remotion 工作流程中，智能体会编辑项目，而渲染器则生成媒体 [ 3 , 4 ] 。 第 5 节将详细说明。 项目访问权限会暴露代码、资源和配置，而这些是仅查看剪辑时无法获取的。 不同的历史过程可能产生相同的视觉事件，因此源标记恢复和动画归属是两个独立的问题。

sents.en: Exported video may conceal its construction history.
sents.zh: 导出的视频可能隐藏其构建历史。

sents.en: Figure 5 separates pixel processing, asset reuse, and clean-source export.
sents.zh: 图 5 将像素处理、资源重用和纯净源导出区分开来。

sents.en: In Claude Code–Remotion workflows, the agent edits a project and the renderer produces media [ 3 , 4 ] .
sents.zh: 在 Claude Code–Remotion 工作流程中，智能体会编辑项目，而渲染器则生成媒体 [ 3 , 4 ] 。

sents.en: Section 5 gives the details.
sents.zh: 第 5 节将详细说明。

sents.en: Project access exposes code, assets, and configuration that a clip-only viewer lacks.
sents.zh: 项目访问权限会暴露代码、资源和配置，而这些是仅查看剪辑时无法获取的。

sents.en: Different histories can produce identical depicted events, so source-mark recovery and animation attribution are separate questions.
sents.zh: 不同的历史过程可能产生相同的视觉事件，因此源标记恢复和动画归属是两个独立的问题。

paragraphs.en: In a teaching animation, the ball must reach its target on time and the caption must describe its motion correctly. Both frame-indexed rendering and video generation can satisfy this task. A study must declare the allowed changes to frame rate, duration, trajectories, captions, and synchronization. It must distinguish retiming of the exported clip from source editing followed by rerendering.
paragraphs.zh: 在教学动画中，球必须准时到达目标位置，且字幕必须正确描述其运动过程。 基于帧索引的渲染和视频生成都能完成这项任务。 研究必须声明帧率、时长、轨迹、字幕和同步方面允许的变化。 研究必须区分导出剪辑的重定时与源编辑后重新渲染的情况。

sents.en: In a teaching animation, the ball must reach its target on time and the caption must describe its motion correctly.
sents.zh: 在教学动画中，球必须准时到达目标位置，且字幕必须正确描述其运动过程。

sents.en: Both frame-indexed rendering and video generation can satisfy this task.
sents.zh: 基于帧索引的渲染和视频生成都能完成这项任务。

sents.en: A study must declare the allowed changes to frame rate, duration, trajectories, captions, and synchronization.
sents.zh: 研究必须声明帧率、时长、轨迹、字幕和同步方面允许的变化。

sents.en: It must distinguish retiming of the exported clip from source editing followed by rerendering.
sents.zh: 研究必须区分导出剪辑的重定时与源编辑后重新渲染的情况。

paragraphs.en: Exporting clean source and assets can bypass output-only marking. Rerendering a marked texture may retain its signal. Neither establishes a general robustness advantage for programs. A guarantee must identify the constrained components and the production event that a retained signal supports.
paragraphs.zh: 导出干净的源代码和资产可以绕过仅输出标记。 重新渲染已标记的纹理可能会保留其信号。 这两者都无法证明程序具有普遍的鲁棒性优势。 任何保证都必须明确受约束的组件以及被保留信号所支持的生产事件。

sents.en: Exporting clean source and assets can bypass output-only marking.
sents.zh: 导出干净的源代码和资产可以绕过仅输出标记。

sents.en: Rerendering a marked texture may retain its signal.
sents.zh: 重新渲染已标记的纹理可能会保留其信号。

sents.en: Neither establishes a general robustness advantage for programs.
sents.zh: 这两者都无法证明程序具有普遍的鲁棒性优势。

sents.en: A guarantee must identify the constrained components and the production event that a retained signal supports.
sents.zh: 任何保证都必须明确受约束的组件以及被保留信号所支持的生产事件。

paragraphs.en: An agent can coordinate both routes within one artifact. Official tool documentation separately describes code execution that produces graph images and specialized image generation [ 5 , 6 ] . Remotion’s Prompt to Video template supplies a concrete composition workflow involving generated scripts, images, and voiceover [ 8 ] . These examples motivate treating an LLM agent as a controller choosing operations, rather than as a third, mutually exclusive visual-production route.
paragraphs.zh: 一个智能体可以在单个工件内协调两条路线。 官方工具文档分别描述了生成图像图表的代码执行以及专门的图像生成方法 [ 5 , 6 ] 。 Remotion 的“提示到视频”模板提供了一个具体的构图工作流程，涉及生成的脚本、图像和旁白 [ 8 ] 。 这些例子促使我们将 LLM 智能体视为一个选择操作的控制器，而不是第三个相互排斥的视觉制作路线。

sents.en: An agent can coordinate both routes within one artifact.
sents.zh: 一个智能体可以在单个工件内协调两条路线。

sents.en: Official tool documentation separately describes code execution that produces graph images and specialized image generation [ 5 , 6 ] .
sents.zh: 官方工具文档分别描述了生成图像图表的代码执行以及专门的图像生成方法 [ 5 , 6 ] 。

sents.en: Remotion’s Prompt to Video template supplies a concrete composition workflow involving generated scripts, images, and voiceover [ 8 ] .
sents.zh: Remotion 的“提示到视频”模板提供了一个具体的构图工作流程，涉及生成的脚本、图像和旁白 [ 8 ] 。

sents.en: These examples motivate treating an LLM agent as a controller choosing operations, rather than as a third, mutually exclusive visual-production route.
sents.zh: 这些例子促使我们将 LLM 智能体视为一个选择操作的控制器，而不是第三个相互排斥的视觉制作路线。

paragraphs.en: Instead of pixels, agent attribution can target an execution record. TRACE combines content-keyed action selection with a trajectory-group record-count channel under a specified log-editing threat model [ 60 ] . Its protected executed-action and no-re-execution assumptions distinguish this trajectory evidence from a viewer’s pixel-only observation.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体归因可以针对执行记录，而非像素。 TRACE 在指定的日志编辑威胁模型下，将内容驱动的动作选择与轨迹组记录计数通道相结合 [ 60 ] 。 其受保护的执行动作以及禁止重复执行的假设，使这种轨迹证据区别于观察者的纯像素级观察。

sents.en: Instead of pixels, agent attribution can target an execution record.
sents.zh: 智能体归因可以针对执行记录，而非像素。

sents.en: TRACE combines content-keyed action selection with a trajectory-group record-count channel under a specified log-editing threat model [ 60 ] .
sents.zh: TRACE 在指定的日志编辑威胁模型下，将内容驱动的动作选择与轨迹组记录计数通道相结合 [ 60 ] 。

sents.en: Its protected executed-action and no-re-execution assumptions distinguish this trajectory evidence from a viewer’s pixel-only observation.
sents.zh: 其受保护的执行动作以及禁止重复执行的假设，使这种轨迹证据区别于观察者的纯像素级观察。

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 illustrates an agent assembling a model-generated background, a plotted curve, and human annotations into a lesson. The plot’s data must remain correct, the annotations must align with the explanation, and the background must retain its intended role. A recovered background mark concerns that contribution and does not establish the authorship of the curve, the annotations, or the entire lesson. Cropping, occlusion, and transitions can also change which contribution is observable. Localized image-message extraction in Watermark Anything supplies a relevant precedent, while leaving video synchronization and complete composition history as separate obligations [ 22 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 图 6 展示了一个智能体如何将模型生成的背景、绘制的曲线和人类标注整合成一节课。 图表中的数据必须保持正确，标注必须与解释一致，而背景也必须保留其预期的作用。 恢复的背景标记仅涉及该贡献部分，并不能确定曲线的作者身份、标注的作者身份或整节课的作者身份。 裁剪、遮挡和过渡效果也可能改变哪些贡献部分是可见的。 Watermark Anything 中的局部化图像消息提取提供了一个相关先例，但视频同步和完整的构图历史仍为独立任务 [22]。

sents.en: Figure 6 illustrates an agent assembling a model-generated background, a plotted curve, and human annotations into a lesson.
sents.zh: 图 6 展示了一个智能体如何将模型生成的背景、绘制的曲线和人类标注整合成一节课。

sents.en: The plot’s data must remain correct, the annotations must align with the explanation, and the background must retain its intended role.
sents.zh: 图表中的数据必须保持正确，标注必须与解释一致，而背景也必须保留其预期的作用。

sents.en: A recovered background mark concerns that contribution and does not establish the authorship of the curve, the annotations, or the entire lesson.
sents.zh: 恢复的背景标记仅涉及该贡献部分，并不能确定曲线的作者身份、标注的作者身份或整节课的作者身份。

sents.en: Cropping, occlusion, and transitions can also change which contribution is observable.
sents.zh: 裁剪、遮挡和过渡效果也可能改变哪些贡献部分是可见的。

sents.en: Localized image-message extraction in Watermark Anything supplies a relevant precedent, while leaving video synchronization and complete composition history as separate obligations [ 22 ] .
sents.zh: Watermark Anything 中的局部化图像消息提取提供了一个相关先例，但视频同步和完整的构图历史仍为独立任务 [22]。

paragraphs.en: Recipients may receive pixels, assets, or production records. The interface must identify the covered contributions and the unobserved production events. Signal survival follows the media path. Task preservation follows each component’s purpose. Authentication identifies who vouches for the history.
paragraphs.zh: 接收方可能会收到像素、资产或生产记录。 接口必须识别已涵盖的贡献以及未观察到的生产事件。 信号存活遵循媒体路径。 任务保留遵循每个组件的目的。 身份验证用于确定谁对历史记录提供担保。

sents.en: Recipients may receive pixels, assets, or production records.
sents.zh: 接收方可能会收到像素、资产或生产记录。

sents.en: The interface must identify the covered contributions and the unobserved production events.
sents.zh: 接口必须识别已涵盖的贡献以及未观察到的生产事件。

sents.en: Signal survival follows the media path.
sents.zh: 信号存活遵循媒体路径。

sents.en: Task preservation follows each component’s purpose.
sents.zh: 任务保留遵循每个组件的目的。

sents.en: Authentication identifies who vouches for the history.
sents.zh: 身份验证用于确定谁对历史记录提供担保。

paragraphs.en: Official documentation and selected repository sources, accessed on 4 October 2026, identify model outputs, rendering components, and inspectable artifacts. They establish interfaces and implementation boundaries, not adoption frequency or watermark performance. Each case links an operation and its accessible state to the assertion it could support and the evidence still needed.
paragraphs.zh: 官方文档和选定的仓库资源（访问日期：2026年10月4日）明确了模型输出、渲染组件以及可检查的产物。 它们定义了接口和实施边界，而非采用频率或水印性能。 每个案例都将一个操作及其可访问状态与它能支持的断言以及仍需要的证据关联起来。

sents.en: Official documentation and selected repository sources, accessed on 4 October 2026, identify model outputs, rendering components, and inspectable artifacts.
sents.zh: 官方文档和选定的仓库资源（访问日期：2026年10月4日）明确了模型输出、渲染组件以及可检查的产物。

sents.en: They establish interfaces and implementation boundaries, not adoption frequency or watermark performance.
sents.zh: 它们定义了接口和实施边界，而非采用频率或水印性能。

sents.en: Each case links an operation and its accessible state to the assertion it could support and the evidence still needed.
sents.zh: 每个案例都将一个操作及其可访问状态与它能支持的断言以及仍需要的证据关联起来。

paragraphs.en: The assistant supplies code; a separate pipeline renders it. Remotion’s tutorial covers Claude Code project creation, skills, and preview setup, and Claude Code documents file editing and command execution [ 4 , 3 ] . Remotion separately documents component-code generation, compilation, and rendering [ 61 ] . That provider-specific example is not a Claude API example.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体提供代码；一个独立的流程负责渲染该代码。 Remotion 的教程涵盖了使用 Claude Code 创建项目、技能以及设置预览，而 Claude Code 的文档则介绍了文件编辑和命令执行 [ 4 , 3 ] 。 Remotion 单独记录了组件代码的生成、编译和渲染过程 [ 61 ] 。 那个特定于提供商的例子并非 Claude API 的例子。

sents.en: The assistant supplies code; a separate pipeline renders it.
sents.zh: 智能体提供代码；一个独立的流程负责渲染该代码。

sents.en: Remotion’s tutorial covers Claude Code project creation, skills, and preview setup, and Claude Code documents file editing and command execution [ 4 , 3 ] .
sents.zh: Remotion 的教程涵盖了使用 Claude Code 创建项目、技能以及设置预览，而 Claude Code 的文档则介绍了文件编辑和命令执行 [ 4 , 3 ] 。

sents.en: Remotion separately documents component-code generation, compilation, and rendering [ 61 ] .
sents.zh: Remotion 单独记录了组件代码的生成、编译和渲染过程 [ 61 ] 。

sents.en: That provider-specific example is not a Claude API example.
sents.zh: 那个特定于提供商的例子并非 Claude API 的例子。

paragraphs.en: In a public creator walkthrough, Sanjaya describes opening a Remotion project in Claude Code and iterating on the requested animation [ 62 ] . Sanjaya then describes adding images and a Sketchfab background model [ 63 ] . This creator report illustrates why code authorship, asset origin, and final rendering are separate provenance questions.
paragraphs.zh: 在一次面向公众的创作者讲解中，Sanjaya 描述了在 Claude Code 中打开一个 Remotion 项目，并对所要求的动画进行迭代 [ 62 ] 。 Sanjaya 接着描述了添加图像和 Sketchfab 背景模型的过程 [ 63 ] 。 这份创作者报告说明了为何代码创作、资产来源和最终渲染是三个独立的来源问题。

sents.en: In a public creator walkthrough, Sanjaya describes opening a Remotion project in Claude Code and iterating on the requested animation [ 62 ] .
sents.zh: 在一次面向公众的创作者讲解中，Sanjaya 描述了在 Claude Code 中打开一个 Remotion 项目，并对所要求的动画进行迭代 [ 62 ] 。

sents.en: Sanjaya then describes adding images and a Sketchfab background model [ 63 ] .
sents.zh: Sanjaya 接着描述了添加图像和 Sketchfab 背景模型的过程 [ 63 ] 。

sents.en: This creator report illustrates why code authorship, asset origin, and final rendering are separate provenance questions.
sents.zh: 这份创作者报告说明了为何代码创作、资产来源和最终渲染是三个独立的来源问题。

paragraphs.en: The server API separates bundling, composition selection, and rendering [ 13 ] . Source files, dependencies, resources, inputs, and configuration affect execution, and media controls include input properties, codec, metadata, and frame range [ 64 ] . Operators may inspect these objects, but viewers receive the export. A stored source version alone does not establish the configuration used for that file.
paragraphs.zh: 服务器 API 将捆绑、组合选择和渲染分离开来 [ 13 ] 。 源文件、依赖项、资源、输入和配置会影响执行，而媒体控制则包括输入属性、编解码器、元数据和帧范围 [ 64 ] 。 操作者可以检查这些对象，但查看器只会收到导出结果。 仅凭已存储的源版本本身，无法确定该文件所使用的具体配置。

sents.en: The server API separates bundling, composition selection, and rendering [ 13 ] .
sents.zh: 服务器 API 将捆绑、组合选择和渲染分离开来 [ 13 ] 。

sents.en: Source files, dependencies, resources, inputs, and configuration affect execution, and media controls include input properties, codec, metadata, and frame range [ 64 ] .
sents.zh: 源文件、依赖项、资源、输入和配置会影响执行，而媒体控制则包括输入属性、编解码器、元数据和帧范围 [ 64 ] 。

sents.en: Operators may inspect these objects, but viewers receive the export.
sents.zh: 操作者可以检查这些对象，但查看器只会收到导出结果。

sents.en: A stored source version alone does not establish the configuration used for that file.
sents.zh: 仅凭已存储的源版本本身，无法确定该文件所使用的具体配置。

paragraphs.en: In the inspected repository snapshot, media export renders and stitches frames, and related sources manage the browser, seek, and capture each frame [ 46 , 65 , 47 , 48 ] . These snapshot-specific observations locate potential evidence at source preparation, frame production, and export. They do not establish which invocation produced a delivered file or describe every released package.
paragraphs.zh: 在受检的仓库快照中，媒体导出会渲染和拼接帧，相关源则负责管理浏览器、定位并捕获每一帧 [ 46 , 65 , 47 , 48 ] 。 这些针对快照的观察结果，有助于在源准备、帧生成和导出环节定位潜在证据。 但它们并未确定是哪个调用生成了交付的文件，也未描述每个已发布的包。

sents.en: In the inspected repository snapshot, media export renders and stitches frames, and related sources manage the browser, seek, and capture each frame [ 46 , 65 , 47 , 48 ] .
sents.zh: 在受检的仓库快照中，媒体导出会渲染和拼接帧，相关源则负责管理浏览器、定位并捕获每一帧 [ 46 , 65 , 47 , 48 ] 。

sents.en: These snapshot-specific observations locate potential evidence at source preparation, frame production, and export.
sents.zh: 这些针对快照的观察结果，有助于在源准备、帧生成和导出环节定位潜在证据。

sents.en: They do not establish which invocation produced a delivered file or describe every released package.
sents.zh: 但它们并未确定是哪个调用生成了交付的文件，也未描述每个已发布的包。

paragraphs.en: Rendering backends expose different boundaries. Remotion’s browser backend takes a component, configuration, and input properties through @remotion/web-renderer. It documents WebCodecs and Mediabunny, skips server bundling, and restricts supported HTML [ 14 ] . A successful preview thus does not establish exportability through this backend. The component, runtime, and supported operations remain part of the production specification.
paragraphs.zh: 渲染后端暴露了不同的边界。 Remotion 的浏览器后端通过 @remotion/web-renderer 接收一个组件、配置和输入属性。 它记录了 WebCodecs 和 Mediabunny，跳过了服务器端打包，并限制了支持的 HTML [ 14 ]。 因此，成功的预览并不能通过此后端确定可导出性。 该组件、运行时以及支持的操作仍然是生产规格的一部分。

sents.en: Rendering backends expose different boundaries.
sents.zh: 渲染后端暴露了不同的边界。

sents.en: Remotion’s browser backend takes a component, configuration, and input properties through @remotion/web-renderer.
sents.zh: Remotion 的浏览器后端通过 @remotion/web-renderer 接收一个组件、配置和输入属性。

sents.en: It documents WebCodecs and Mediabunny, skips server bundling, and restricts supported HTML [ 14 ] .
sents.zh: 它记录了 WebCodecs 和 Mediabunny，跳过了服务器端打包，并限制了支持的 HTML [ 14 ]。

sents.en: A successful preview thus does not establish exportability through this backend.
sents.zh: 因此，成功的预览并不能通过此后端确定可导出性。

sents.en: The component, runtime, and supported operations remain part of the production specification.
sents.zh: 该组件、运行时以及支持的操作仍然是生产规格的一部分。

paragraphs.en: Remotion Lambda documents S3 deployment, parallel chunk rendering, stitching, and S3 output [ 15 ] . Evidence from one cloud component concerns that component’s work. Binding it to the final file requires relationships to the other chunks and export. Changing the rendering backend changes execution, observation, and deployment control without itself changing program authorship.
paragraphs.zh: Remotion Lambda 文档记录了 S3 部署、并行分块渲染、拼接以及 S3 输出 [ 15 ] 。 来自某个云组件的证据仅涉及该组件的工作。 将其绑定到最终文件需要与其他分块和导出建立关联。 更改渲染后端会改变执行、观察和部署控制，但本身并不会改变程序的作者归属。

sents.en: Remotion Lambda documents S3 deployment, parallel chunk rendering, stitching, and S3 output [ 15 ] .
sents.zh: Remotion Lambda 文档记录了 S3 部署、并行分块渲染、拼接以及 S3 输出 [ 15 ] 。

sents.en: Evidence from one cloud component concerns that component’s work.
sents.zh: 来自某个云组件的证据仅涉及该组件的工作。

sents.en: Binding it to the final file requires relationships to the other chunks and export.
sents.zh: 将其绑定到最终文件需要与其他分块和导出建立关联。

sents.en: Changing the rendering backend changes execution, observation, and deployment control without itself changing program authorship.
sents.zh: 更改渲染后端会改变执行、观察和部署控制，但本身并不会改变程序的作者归属。

paragraphs.en: The same distinction appears before time is introduced: static images already involve distinct operations and distinct observable artifacts. OpenAI documents Code Interpreter as executing Python and producing files such as graph images [ 5 ] . OpenAI separately documents an image-generation tool based on GPT Image models [ 6 ] . These are distinct available operations. Identifying the assistant that returned a picture does not specify which operation produced it, and a proposed tool invocation does not establish successful execution.
paragraphs.zh: 在引入时间之前，同样的区别就已经存在：静态图像本身已经涉及不同的操作和不同的可观察产物。 OpenAI 的文档指出，Code Interpreter 可以执行 Python 并生成文件，例如图表图像 [ 5 ] 。 OpenAI 还单独介绍了一款基于 GPT Image 模型的图片生成工具 [ 6 ] 。 这些是不同的可用操作。 识别出返回图片的助手，并不能说明是哪一项操作生成了该图片；而提出的工具调用也无法证明执行已成功完成。

sents.en: The same distinction appears before time is introduced: static images already involve distinct operations and distinct observable artifacts.
sents.zh: 在引入时间之前，同样的区别就已经存在：静态图像本身已经涉及不同的操作和不同的可观察产物。

sents.en: OpenAI documents Code Interpreter as executing Python and producing files such as graph images [ 5 ] .
sents.zh: OpenAI 的文档指出，Code Interpreter 可以执行 Python 并生成文件，例如图表图像 [ 5 ] 。

sents.en: OpenAI separately documents an image-generation tool based on GPT Image models [ 6 ] .
sents.zh: OpenAI 还单独介绍了一款基于 GPT Image 模型的图片生成工具 [ 6 ] 。

sents.en: These are distinct available operations.
sents.zh: 这些是不同的可用操作。

sents.en: Identifying the assistant that returned a picture does not specify which operation produced it, and a proposed tool invocation does not establish successful execution.
sents.zh: 识别出返回图片的助手，并不能说明是哪一项操作生成了该图片；而提出的工具调用也无法证明执行已成功完成。

paragraphs.en: Claude’s custom-visuals documentation describes HTML-based diagrams and charts with SVG or HTML downloads [ 7 ] . A downloaded description, an interactive display, and a screenshot expose different state. The SVG specification distinguishes the document tree from the rendering tree [ 59 ] . Matplotlib’s export documentation likewise distinguishes formats whose availability depends on the backend [ 58 ] . Source-visible evidence can therefore concern an editable description even when a pixel-only verifier receives only its appearance.
paragraphs.zh: Claude 的自定义视觉文档描述了基于 HTML 的图表和图形，并提供 SVG 或 HTML 下载选项 [ 7 ] 。 下载的描述、交互式显示和截图展示了不同的状态。 SVG 规范将文档树与渲染树区分开来 [ 59 ] 。 Matplotlib 的导出文档同样区分了那些可用性取决于后端环境的格式 [ 58 ] 。 因此，即使像素级验证器仅接收到最终外观，源代码中可见的证据仍可能涉及可编辑的描述。

sents.en: Claude’s custom-visuals documentation describes HTML-based diagrams and charts with SVG or HTML downloads [ 7 ] .
sents.zh: Claude 的自定义视觉文档描述了基于 HTML 的图表和图形，并提供 SVG 或 HTML 下载选项 [ 7 ] 。

sents.en: A downloaded description, an interactive display, and a screenshot expose different state.
sents.zh: 下载的描述、交互式显示和截图展示了不同的状态。

sents.en: The SVG specification distinguishes the document tree from the rendering tree [ 59 ] .
sents.zh: SVG 规范将文档树与渲染树区分开来 [ 59 ] 。

sents.en: Matplotlib’s export documentation likewise distinguishes formats whose availability depends on the backend [ 58 ] .
sents.zh: Matplotlib 的导出文档同样区分了那些可用性取决于后端环境的格式 [ 58 ] 。

sents.en: Source-visible evidence can therefore concern an editable description even when a pixel-only verifier receives only its appearance.
sents.zh: 因此，即使像素级验证器仅接收到最终外观，源代码中可见的证据仍可能涉及可编辑的描述。

paragraphs.en: The consulted Artifacts help page lists particular export formats but does not supply a general MP4-export promise [ 66 ] . Broader capability claims would require additional evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 所查阅的 Artifacts 帮助页面列出了特定的导出格式，但并未承诺支持通用的 MP4 导出 [ 66 ]。 更广泛的功能主张需要更多证据来支持。

sents.en: The consulted Artifacts help page lists particular export formats but does not supply a general MP4-export promise [ 66 ] .
sents.zh: 所查阅的 Artifacts 帮助页面列出了特定的导出格式，但并未承诺支持通用的 MP4 导出 [ 66 ]。

sents.en: Broader capability claims would require additional evidence.
sents.zh: 更广泛的功能主张需要更多证据来支持。

paragraphs.en: Mixed workflows need contribution and handoff evidence. Remotion’s Prompt to Video combines generated script, images, and voiceover using OpenAI and ElevenLabs [ 8 ] . Its markup guidance permits media resources [ 67 ] . Generated assets thus enter an authored composition before rendering and encoding.
paragraphs.zh: 混合工作流需要贡献和交接的证据。 Remotion 的“提示到视频”功能结合生成的脚本、图像和语音旁白，并使用 OpenAI 与 ElevenLabs [ 8 ] 。 其标记指导支持媒体资源 [ 67 ] 。 因此，生成的资产在进入渲染和编码之前，会先进入一个由作者构建的构图中。

sents.en: Mixed workflows need contribution and handoff evidence.
sents.zh: 混合工作流需要贡献和交接的证据。

sents.en: Remotion’s Prompt to Video combines generated script, images, and voiceover using OpenAI and ElevenLabs [ 8 ] .
sents.zh: Remotion 的“提示到视频”功能结合生成的脚本、图像和语音旁白，并使用 OpenAI 与 ElevenLabs [ 8 ] 。

sents.en: Its markup guidance permits media resources [ 67 ] .
sents.zh: 其标记指导支持媒体资源 [ 67 ] 。

sents.en: Generated assets thus enter an authored composition before rendering and encoding.
sents.zh: 因此，生成的资产在进入渲染和编码之前，会先进入一个由作者构建的构图中。

paragraphs.en: Asset producers, composition authors, controllers, and exporters observe different stages. Producers may not see later cropping, overlays, or reuse. Exporters may lack authenticated input histories. Evidence must connect asset identity, retained contribution, and export scope, because recorded ancestry alone does not establish visibility.
paragraphs.zh: 资产生成者、组合创作者、控制器和导出器会观察到不同的阶段。 生成者可能无法看到后续的裁剪、叠加或重用操作。 导出器可能缺乏经过验证的输入历史记录。 证据必须关联资产身份、保留的贡献以及导出范围，因为仅凭记录的历史渊源并不能确立可见性。

sents.en: Asset producers, composition authors, controllers, and exporters observe different stages.
sents.zh: 资产生成者、组合创作者、控制器和导出器会观察到不同的阶段。

sents.en: Producers may not see later cropping, overlays, or reuse.
sents.zh: 生成者可能无法看到后续的裁剪、叠加或重用操作。

sents.en: Exporters may lack authenticated input histories.
sents.zh: 导出器可能缺乏经过验证的输入历史记录。

sents.en: Evidence must connect asset identity, retained contribution, and export scope, because recorded ancestry alone does not establish visibility.
sents.zh: 证据必须关联资产身份、保留的贡献以及导出范围，因为仅凭记录的历史渊源并不能确立可见性。

paragraphs.en: Existing upstream evidence does not settle its downstream interpretation. Anthropic documents text watermarking for supported models and C2PA credentials for supported generated files, with coverage and capabilities depending on the model or platform [ 68 ] . The documentation also qualifies what detection establishes and notes that transformations such as conversion or screenshots can remove metadata. These statements make upstream marking part of the production analysis. Source-to-render inheritance still needs examination for each carrier and workflow.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的上游证据尚未明确其下游解释。 Anthropic 为支持的模型提供了文本水印，并为支持的生成文件提供了 C2PA 凭证，其覆盖范围和功能取决于具体模型或平台 [68]。 该文档还说明了检测功能所能确认的内容，并指出转换或截图等操作可能会移除元数据。 这些声明将上游标记纳入了生产分析的一部分。 对于每种载体和工作流，仍需进一步研究从源到渲染的继承问题。

sents.en: Existing upstream evidence does not settle its downstream interpretation.
sents.zh: 现有的上游证据尚未明确其下游解释。

sents.en: Anthropic documents text watermarking for supported models and C2PA credentials for supported generated files, with coverage and capabilities depending on the model or platform [ 68 ] .
sents.zh: Anthropic 为支持的模型提供了文本水印，并为支持的生成文件提供了 C2PA 凭证，其覆盖范围和功能取决于具体模型或平台 [68]。

sents.en: The documentation also qualifies what detection establishes and notes that transformations such as conversion or screenshots can remove metadata.
sents.zh: 该文档还说明了检测功能所能确认的内容，并指出转换或截图等操作可能会移除元数据。

sents.en: These statements make upstream marking part of the production analysis.
sents.zh: 这些声明将上游标记纳入了生产分析的一部分。

sents.en: Source-to-render inheritance still needs examination for each carrier and workflow.
sents.zh: 对于每种载体和工作流，仍需进一步研究从源到渲染的继承问题。

paragraphs.en: C2PA also supports watermark or fingerprint soft bindings (Appendix D ): a retained manifest may be located after metadata loss, with region or time scopes available [ 12 , Sections 9.3 and 18.10] . Soft matching complements signed assertions and does not replace hard cryptographic binding. Thus metadata loss alone is not a sufficient motivation for a new credential mechanism. Questions 9 and 10 must compare with signed records plus soft-binding lookup, while specifying matching accuracy, authorized production-event relations, repository access, and privacy. These capabilities do not imply that a source-code watermark survives external video rendering.
paragraphs.zh: C2PA 还支持水印或指纹的软绑定（附录 D）：在元数据丢失后，仍可能找到保留的清单，并支持区域或时间范围 [12，第 9.3 节和第 18.10 节]。 软匹配可补充签名断言，但不能替代硬加密绑定。 因此，仅凭元数据丢失本身并不足以成为引入新凭证机制的理由。 问题 9 和 10 必须与签名记录及软绑定查询进行比较，同时明确匹配准确性、授权生产事件关系、存储库访问权限以及隐私性。 这些功能并不意味着源代码水印能在外部视频渲染后仍然存在。

sents.en: C2PA also supports watermark or fingerprint soft bindings (Appendix D ): a retained manifest may be located after metadata loss, with region or time scopes available [ 12 , Sections 9.3 and 18.10] .
sents.zh: C2PA 还支持水印或指纹的软绑定（附录 D）：在元数据丢失后，仍可能找到保留的清单，并支持区域或时间范围 [12，第 9.3 节和第 18.10 节]。

sents.en: Soft matching complements signed assertions and does not replace hard cryptographic binding.
sents.zh: 软匹配可补充签名断言，但不能替代硬加密绑定。

sents.en: Thus metadata loss alone is not a sufficient motivation for a new credential mechanism.
sents.zh: 因此，仅凭元数据丢失本身并不足以成为引入新凭证机制的理由。

sents.en: Questions 9 and 10 must compare with signed records plus soft-binding lookup, while specifying matching accuracy, authorized production-event relations, repository access, and privacy.
sents.zh: 问题 9 和 10 必须与签名记录及软绑定查询进行比较，同时明确匹配准确性、授权生产事件关系、存储库访问权限以及隐私性。

sents.en: These capabilities do not imply that a source-code watermark survives external video rendering.
sents.zh: 这些功能并不意味着源代码水印能在外部视频渲染后仍然存在。

paragraphs.en: Deployment determines who can inspect source, invoke rendering, retain logs, and issue evidence. Public verification and secret issuance are distinct arrangements. If a proposed design places an issuance secret inside client code available to its attacker, its security argument must account for that access. A managed service can impose different access conditions. The specification must state these conditions alongside the trust placed in its execution records.
paragraphs.zh: 部署决定了谁可以检查源代码、调用渲染功能、保留日志以及签发证据。 公开验证与秘密签发是两种不同的安排。 如果某个拟议的设计将签发密钥置于客户端代码中，而攻击者能够访问该代码，那么其安全论证必须考虑到这种访问权限。 托管服务可以施加不同的访问条件。 规范文件必须在说明对其执行记录所建立的信任的同时，明确列出这些条件。

sents.en: Deployment determines who can inspect source, invoke rendering, retain logs, and issue evidence.
sents.zh: 部署决定了谁可以检查源代码、调用渲染功能、保留日志以及签发证据。

sents.en: Public verification and secret issuance are distinct arrangements.
sents.zh: 公开验证与秘密签发是两种不同的安排。

sents.en: If a proposed design places an issuance secret inside client code available to its attacker, its security argument must account for that access.
sents.zh: 如果某个拟议的设计将签发密钥置于客户端代码中，而攻击者能够访问该代码，那么其安全论证必须考虑到这种访问权限。

sents.en: A managed service can impose different access conditions.
sents.zh: 托管服务可以施加不同的访问条件。

sents.en: The specification must state these conditions alongside the trust placed in its execution records.
sents.zh: 规范文件必须在说明对其执行记录所建立的信任的同时，明确列出这些条件。

paragraphs.en: Intervention, decoding, and provenance assertions can concern different production stages, so the ten Questions below match these objects before optimizing detection:
paragraphs.zh: 干预、解码和来源声明可能涉及不同的生产阶段，因此在下文优化检测之前，以下十个问题会先匹配这些对象：

paragraphs.en: Vector descriptions and raster observations.
paragraphs.zh: 矢量描述与栅格观测。

paragraphs.en: Fair comparison across intervention stages.
paragraphs.zh: 干预阶段间的公平比较。

paragraphs.en: Recoverable payload under task constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 任务约束下的可恢复有效载荷。

paragraphs.en: Reconstruction with access to production state.
paragraphs.zh: 在可访问生产状态的情况下进行重建。

paragraphs.en: Content-bound, privacy-aware credentials.
paragraphs.zh: 内容绑定、隐私感知的凭证。

paragraphs.en: A Question states its Setting, the Success criterion, a Baseline, and the Deliverable sought, and, where useful, a First case and what is Not asked, meaning the variants it excludes. In Question 6 , Success describes the attack.
paragraphs.zh: 一个问题会说明其背景、成功标准、基准以及所期望的成果，并在适当的情况下说明第一个案例以及问题未涉及的内容，即其所排除的变体。 在问题 6 中，“成功”部分描述了攻击过程。

sents.en: A Question states its Setting, the Success criterion, a Baseline, and the Deliverable sought, and, where useful, a First case and what is Not asked, meaning the variants it excludes.
sents.zh: 一个问题会说明其背景、成功标准、基准以及所期望的成果，并在适当的情况下说明第一个案例以及问题未涉及的内容，即其所排除的变体。

sents.en: In Question 6 , Success describes the attack.
sents.zh: 在问题 6 中，“成功”部分描述了攻击过程。

paragraphs.en: Finite instances are starting checks. The intended deliverable is:
paragraphs.zh: 有限实例是初始检查。 预期的交付成果是：

sents.en: Finite instances are starting checks.
sents.zh: 有限实例是初始检查。

sents.en: The intended deliverable is:
sents.zh: 预期的交付成果是：

paragraphs.en: a bound that varies with declared parameters;
paragraphs.zh: 一个随声明参数变化的界限；

paragraphs.en: Enumerating one instance alone supplies none of these. The formulation of a Question does not certify that every variant is globally open. A natural first project is Question 2 ’s carrier recoverable across a population without clean reference frames. Question 5 then asks how its payload scales.
paragraphs.zh: 仅枚举单个实例无法提供这些中的任何一项。 问题的提出并不证明每种变体都在全局范围内开放。 一个自然的初始任务是：在没有干净参考系的情况下，问题 2 的载体能否在整个群体中恢复。 问题 5 接着询问其有效载荷如何扩展。

sents.en: Enumerating one instance alone supplies none of these.
sents.zh: 仅枚举单个实例无法提供这些中的任何一项。

sents.en: The formulation of a Question does not certify that every variant is globally open.
sents.zh: 问题的提出并不证明每种变体都在全局范围内开放。

sents.en: A natural first project is Question 2 ’s carrier recoverable across a population without clean reference frames.
sents.zh: 一个自然的初始任务是：在没有干净参考系的情况下，问题 2 的载体能否在整个群体中恢复。

sents.en: Question 5 then asks how its payload scales.
sents.zh: 问题 5 接着询问其有效载荷如何扩展。

paragraphs.en: A provenance distinction must survive the declared observation. Passive inference starts with production distributions and a label, not merely a contrast between product names. Appendix A shows both extremes: identical label-conditional observation laws give no classification advantage over the prior alone (Corollary A.7 ), but different mixtures of the same renderer can remain distinguishable (Example A.8 ). Side information may change the problem. These distinctions motivate a precise label and an explicit abstention policy.
paragraphs.zh: 来源区分必须在声明的观察结果中得以保留。 被动推理始于生成分布和一个标签，而不仅仅是产品名称之间的对比。 附录 A 展示了两种极端情况：相同的标签条件观察定律相较于仅使用先验信息并不会带来任何分类优势（推论 A.7），但同一渲染器的不同混合版本仍然可能保持可区分性（示例 A.8）。 辅助信息可能会改变问题本身。 这些区分促使我们采用精确的标签和明确的弃权策略。

sents.en: A provenance distinction must survive the declared observation.
sents.zh: 来源区分必须在声明的观察结果中得以保留。

sents.en: Passive inference starts with production distributions and a label, not merely a contrast between product names.
sents.zh: 被动推理始于生成分布和一个标签，而不仅仅是产品名称之间的对比。

sents.en: Appendix A shows both extremes: identical label-conditional observation laws give no classification advantage over the prior alone (Corollary A.7 ), but different mixtures of the same renderer can remain distinguishable (Example A.8 ).
sents.zh: 附录 A 展示了两种极端情况：相同的标签条件观察定律相较于仅使用先验信息并不会带来任何分类优势（推论 A.7），但同一渲染器的不同混合版本仍然可能保持可区分性（示例 A.8）。

sents.en: Side information may change the problem.
sents.zh: 辅助信息可能会改变问题本身。

sents.en: These distinctions motivate a precise label and an explicit abstention policy.
sents.zh: 这些区分促使我们采用精确的标签和明确的弃权策略。

paragraphs.en: Ask. How accurately can a verifier infer the production route, image/video generation or code-based rendering, from its observation if it may abstain?
paragraphs.zh: 提问。 如果验证器可以选择弃权，那么仅凭其观察结果，它能多准确地推断出生成过程是路线规划、图像/视频生成还是基于代码的渲染？

sents.en: Ask.
sents.zh: 提问。

sents.en: How accurately can a verifier infer the production route, image/video generation or code-based rendering, from its observation if it may abstain?
sents.zh: 如果验证器可以选择弃权，那么仅凭其观察结果，它能多准确地推断出生成过程是路线规划、图像/视频生成还是基于代码的渲染？

paragraphs.en: Setting. Both routes draw intended content from one parameterized scene family by a common rule. Declare the nuisance-policy families, including whether they may differ by route and admit randomized mixtures. A nuisance policy is a rule by which a route chooses implementation details, such as which program or seed realizes a scene, that do not change the intended content. The verifier observes the received artifact plus any declared side observations. Compare a fixed menu of such side observations with stated trust and disclosure costs; grant no free authenticated route-label bit.
paragraphs.zh: 设定。 两条路线都通过一条通用规则，从同一个参数化场景族中提取预期内容。 声明干扰策略族，包括它们是否可以因路线而异以及是否允许随机混合。 干扰策略是一条规则，据此路线选择实现细节（例如，使用哪个程序或种子来生成一个场景），而这些细节不会改变预期内容。 验证器会观察接收到的产物以及任何已声明的附加观察结果。 将此类附加观察结果的固定清单与声明的信任成本和披露成本进行比较；不得授予任何免费的、经过认证的路线标签位。

sents.en: Setting.
sents.zh: 设定。

sents.en: Both routes draw intended content from one parameterized scene family by a common rule.
sents.zh: 两条路线都通过一条通用规则，从同一个参数化场景族中提取预期内容。

sents.en: Declare the nuisance-policy families, including whether they may differ by route and admit randomized mixtures.
sents.zh: 声明干扰策略族，包括它们是否可以因路线而异以及是否允许随机混合。

sents.en: A nuisance policy is a rule by which a route chooses implementation details, such as which program or seed realizes a scene, that do not change the intended content.
sents.zh: 干扰策略是一条规则，据此路线选择实现细节（例如，使用哪个程序或种子来生成一个场景），而这些细节不会改变预期内容。

sents.en: The verifier observes the received artifact plus any declared side observations.
sents.zh: 验证器会观察接收到的产物以及任何已声明的附加观察结果。

sents.en: Compare a fixed menu of such side observations with stated trust and disclosure costs; grant no free authenticated route-label bit.
sents.zh: 将此类附加观察结果的固定清单与声明的信任成本和披露成本进行比较；不得授予任何免费的、经过认证的路线标签位。

paragraphs.en: Success. Minimize the worst-case, equal-prior probability of a wrong, non-abstaining report. Take the worst case over the declared nuisance-policy families, with scene content drawn by the common rule in both routes. Require non-abstention coverage at least κ ∈ ( 0 , 1 ] \kappa\in(0,1] under each route and allowed nuisance policy.
paragraphs.zh: 成功。 最小化错误且非弃权报告在最坏情况下的等先验概率。 在所有声明的干扰策略族中取最坏情况，其中场景内容由两条路线中的共同规则生成。 要求每条路线和每种允许的干扰策略下，非弃权覆盖至少为 κ ∈ (0,1]。

sents.en: Success.
sents.zh: 成功。

sents.en: Minimize the worst-case, equal-prior probability of a wrong, non-abstaining report.
sents.zh: 最小化错误且非弃权报告在最坏情况下的等先验概率。

sents.en: Take the worst case over the declared nuisance-policy families, with scene content drawn by the common rule in both routes.
sents.zh: 在所有声明的干扰策略族中取最坏情况，其中场景内容由两条路线中的共同规则生成。

sents.en: Require non-abstention coverage at least κ ∈ ( 0 , 1 ] \kappa\in(0,1] under each route and allowed nuisance policy.
sents.zh: 要求每条路线和每种允许的干扰策略下，非弃权覆盖至少为 κ ∈ (0,1]。

paragraphs.en: Baseline. For fully known finite laws without abstention, Proposition A.2 gives the Bayes benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 基线。 对于没有禁用的完全已知的有限定律，命题 A.2 给出了贝叶斯基准。

sents.en: Baseline.
sents.zh: 基线。

sents.en: For fully known finite laws without abstention, Proposition A.2 gives the Bayes benchmark.
sents.zh: 对于没有禁用的完全已知的有限定律，命题 A.2 给出了贝叶斯基准。

paragraphs.en: Deliverable. A uniform criterion or bound as scene and nuisance budgets vary. Exhibit both separated and indistinguishable families.
paragraphs.zh: 交付成果。 一个统一的标准或界限，因为场景和干扰预算各不相同。 同时展示可分离和不可区分的家族。

sents.en: Deliverable.

paragraphs.en: Active marking, unlike passive inference, asks which allowed changes to a representation reach the decoder after the remaining pipeline. The answer can depend on the rendering environment, quantization, and what the verifier receives. Analyze separately a source-only distinction that disappears in rasterization and an asset intervention designed to affect pixels.
paragraphs.zh: 与被动推理不同，主动标记会询问：在其余处理流程之后，对表示的哪些允许更改能够到达解码器。 答案可能取决于渲染环境、量化方式以及验证器接收到的内容。 需要分别分析两种情况：一种是在光栅化过程中消失的仅源于输入的差异，另一种是旨在影响像素的资产干预。

paragraphs.en: The running task is a bar-chart animation with prescribed values, labels, and monotone growth, T T sampled frames, and q q quantized height levels under a fixed rasterizer. Task-preserving timing variation supplies a candidate carrier that quantization and edits can remove. Example B.4 in Appendix B gives an explicit task-allowed trajectory. A program family can expose its timing coefficients directly. We do not assume that an image/video model realizes the same trajectories. A comparison using an image/video model must declare its decoding map and reachable interventions. The task connects observability, payload, synchronization, and reconstruction without identifying them with one another.
paragraphs.zh: 正在运行的任务是一个柱状图动画，具有预定的数值、标签和单调增长特性，包含 T 个采样帧和 q 个量化高度层级，并在固定的光栅化器下运行。 保留任务特性的时间变化提供了一个候选载体，该载体可被量化和编辑所移除。 附录 B 中的示例 B.4 给出了一个明确的任务允许轨迹。 一个程序族可以直接暴露其时间系数。 我们不假设图像/视频模型能够实现相同的轨迹。 使用图像/视频模型进行比较时，必须声明其解码映射和可达的干预措施。 该任务将可观察性、有效载荷、同步和重建联系起来，但并未将它们彼此等同。

paragraphs.en: A source-format guarantee is not automatically an exported-image guarantee. SVG makes the observation change concrete. paragraphs.en: Compare interventions with matched information and permissions. Classical information embedding distinguishes decoding without the unmarked reference (host-blind) from known-host decoding and studies rate–distortion–robustness tradeoffs [ 69 ] . The comparisons here must instantiate that baseline with task predicates, reachable interventions, and renderer environments. An upstream encoder may know state that an output-only encoder lacks, and both routes share a pixel-stage baseline. In Example B.6 , two scene descriptions render the same solid square but store different hidden anchor values that the baseline renderer ignores. This shows non-emulation, not a performance separation.
paragraphs.zh: 将干预措施与匹配的信息和权限进行比较。 经典信息嵌入区分了在没有未标记参考（主机盲）情况下的解码与已知主机的解码，并研究了速率–失真–鲁棒性之间的权衡 [69]。 此处的比较必须通过任务谓词、可达干预措施和渲染器环境来具体化该基线。 上游编码器可能知道仅输出型编码器所缺乏的状态，且两种路径共享一个像素阶段的基线。 在示例 B.6 中，两个场景描述渲染出相同的实心正方形，但存储了不同的隐藏锚点值，而基线渲染器会忽略这些值。 这表明这是非模拟，而非性能上的分离。
